I need to add error bars to my genomics plots but my PI didn't specify what type. Should I be using standard deviation, standard error, or confidence intervals for things like gene expression boxplots and qPCR validation graphs?

For gene expression boxplots, I'd actually lean toward standard deviation since boxplots already show quartiles and you want to show the full spread of your biological replicates. For qPCR validation where you're comparing means between conditions, standard error makes more sense since you're focused on the precision of those mean estimates.

What about for time course experiments where I'm showing gene expression changes over multiple time points? I have like 6 time points with n=4 biological replicates each and I'm plotting mean expression with error bars.

Actually, should I be worried about multiple comparisons when I'm showing all these time points? My PI mentioned something about that but I'm not sure if it applies to just the visualization or if I need to adjust my statistics too.
I'm doing pairwise comparisons against the baseline time point for each gene, so like comparing T1 vs T0, T2 vs T0, etc. Do I need to correct for all those comparisons or just within each gene?

Got it, so if I have 5 comparisons per gene (T1-T5 vs T0), I'd use something like Bonferroni with α=0.05/5=0.01 as my cutoff for each gene. That seems way more reasonable than trying to correct across all genes and time points.

Wait, one more thing - should I be correcting for multiple comparisons if I'm just showing the error bars in my plots but not doing formal statistical tests? Like if I'm just presenting the data visually without p-values?
Perfect, that makes total sense. I was overthinking it - the error bars are just to show the uncertainty in my measurements, not to make statistical claims.

Ina ji kamar na zama ba a ganuwa ga abokaina tun lokacin da na haifi jariri. Kullum suna min text amma yanzu shiru rediyo ne ban sani ba ko zan kai ko in yarda cewa yanzu haka abin yake.

Na ci gaba da tunanin yadda na kasance wanda kowa ke kiran sa don jin daɗin sa'o'i ko shirye-shiryen karshen mako, kuma yanzu ina jin kamar duk sun ci gaba ba tare da ni ba. Shin ya kamata in gaya musu cewa ina fama da jin cewa an rabu da ni ko hakan ya yi yawa don zubar da su?

Na yi ƙoƙarin tuntuɓar babban abokina a makon da ya gabata tare da rubutu na yau da kullun kuma ta ɗauki kwanaki uku don amsawa da wani abu gajere. Kamar yanzu ina damun mutane lokacin da na kasance wanda suke so su ji.

Laifin yana cinye ni don ina jin kamar ya kamata in gode wa wannan kyakkyawar jaririn maimakon haka ina zaune a nan ina kuka na rasa kaina. Shin yana da kyau a ji kamar kuna baƙin cikin tsohuwar rayuwarku ko da kuna ƙaunar ɗanku?

Ta yaya zan bambanta tsakanin daidaitawa ta al'ada da wani abu da ya kamata in damu da shi? Ina jin tsoro cewa idan na yarda cewa ina fama da wannan sosai, wani zai yi tunanin ba zan iya jurewa zama mahaifiya ba.

Kwana uku ban yi wanka ba jiya na yi kuka na tsawon awa daya saboda na kasa gane yadda ake aikin sabuwar kujerar mota. Abokina ya ci gaba da cewa ina yin babban aiki amma ina jin kamar da kyar nake ajiye shi tare.
Shin ya kamata in damu cewa na sami kwanciyar hankali fiye da farin ciki lokacin da jaririn ya yi barci? Wani lokaci ina zaune a can cikin shiru kawai in ji laifi don farin cikin samun hutu da ɗana.
Na kalli hotunana tun kafin a haifi jaririn da kyar na gane mutumin. Ta yi kama da hade da karfin gwiwa kuma ina jin kamar ta tafi har abada.

Ina so in ji dadi game da jariri na yana bugun abubuwa masu mahimmanci kamar yadda kowa yake yi, amma yawanci kawai ina jin gajiya kuma ina tunanin "babban abu, wani abu don damuwa game da ci gaba." Shin hakan ya sa na zama uwa mai muni?
Wani lokaci idan jaririn yana kururuwa kuma ba abin da nake yi yana taimaka wa, Ina tunanin kawai fita daga kofa da shiga motata. Ba zan taɓa yin hakan ba amma tunanin yana tsorata ni.
Na ci gaba da tunanin ko na yi kuskure na haifi jariri? Ba don ba na son su ba, amma don ina jin kamar na rasa kaina gaba ɗaya kuma ban sani ba ko zan sake samun hanyar komawa zama ni.

Har yaushe zan jira kafin in sani idan wannan daidaitawa ce ta al'ada ko kuma ina buƙatar taimako na gaske? Ba na so in wuce gona da iri amma kuma ba na so in bar abin ya yi muni idan da gaske wani abu ya kasance ba daidai ba.

Ina tsammanin ina bukatar yin magana da wani amma ina cikin damuwa game da samun lokaci ko kuzari don ko da yin kira, balle in je alƙawura. Ta yaya sababbin iyaye a zahiri ke sarrafa don samun taimako yayin da suke da kyar aiki?

Na ci gaba da jin kamar ya kamata in ƙara yin bincike game da haɓaka jarirai da karanta littattafan tarbiyyar yara, amma duk lokacin da na gwada sai in ji damuwa kuma kamar ina kasawa a komai. Shin yana da kyau kawai ku rene shi kuma ku amince da hankalina?

A zahiri, abu na ƙarshe - idan na zame na duba kafofin watsa labarunsa, shin har yanzu zan rubuta ta a cikin jarida ko hakan zai ƙarfafa halayen?
Wannan yana da ma'ana - ɗaukar zamewa azaman bayanan bayanai maimakon gazawa. Zan hada su amma in mai da hankali kan fannin ilmantarwa maimakon bugun kaina game da shi.
Mo ti n ṣayẹwo Instagram ti ọkọ mi atijọ ati Facebook ni ọpọlọpọ igba ni ọjọ kan fun ọsẹ meji sẹhin ati pe ara mi korira mi. Kini o n fa ipaniyan yii?

Mo loye wiwa alaye ati awọn aaye lafiwe, ṣugbọn eyi kan lara ipa diẹ sii ju onipin. Emi yoo ṣayẹwo paapaa nigba ti Mo mọ pe yoo jẹ ki n ni rilara buru si - kini ẹrọ imọ-jinlẹ ti o wa lẹhin ilana iparun ara-ẹni yẹn?

Awọn roba band ilana kan lara gimmicky. Mo n wa nkankan ti o koju awọn root àkóbá aini ti o iwakọ yi - bi ohun ti n ni mo ti n gbiyanju lati gba lati yiyewo rẹ awujo media ti mo ti le gba ibomiiran?

Iyẹn jẹ oye ni ọgbọn ṣugbọn Mo tun n tiraka pẹlu abala iṣe. Nigbati mo ba ni imọlara ipadanu ti itara iṣakoso, igbese kan pato wo ni MO le ṣe ni akoko yẹn lati ni rilara bi MO ṣe n gba ibẹwẹ pada lori ipo mi?

Ero iwe akọọlẹ iṣakoso jẹ ohun ti o nifẹ - titọpa awọn okunfa le ṣe iranlọwọ fun mi lati ṣe idanimọ awọn ilana. Ṣugbọn Mo ṣe aniyan nipa titan eyi sinu ihuwasi afẹju miiran nibiti Mo n ṣe abojuto ara mi nigbagbogbo. Bawo ni MO ṣe lo laisi ṣiṣe ni ipaniyan miiran?

Mo ro pe Emi yoo gbiyanju iwe akọọlẹ fun ọsẹ kan ati rii boya awọn ilana ba farahan. Kini MO yẹ ki n ṣe ti MO ba ṣe idanimọ awọn okunfa ṣugbọn wọn ko ṣee ṣe - bii wahala iṣẹ tabi adawa ni awọn ipari ose?

Ni ẹtọ, nitorinaa o jẹ nipa kikọ awọn ilana imudoko fun awọn okunfa kuku ju yago fun wọn patapata. Ohun kan diẹ sii - ṣe Mo sọ fun ẹnikẹni pe Mo n ṣe ọna iwe akọọlẹ yii, tabi o dara julọ lati mu ni ikọkọ ni akọkọ?

Mo ro pe Emi yoo bẹrẹ ni ikọkọ fun bayi ati boya mu wa pẹlu oniwosan ọran mi ni kete ti MO ba kuro ni atokọ iduro. O ṣeun fun ririn nipasẹ eyi pẹlu mi - o ṣe iranlọwọ lati ni ilana kan lati sunmọ eyi ni ọna eto.
Lootọ, ohun kan ti o kẹhin - ti MO ba yọkuro ki o ṣayẹwo media awujọ rẹ, ṣe Mo tun ṣe igbasilẹ rẹ sinu iwe akọọlẹ tabi ṣe iyẹn yoo kan mu ihuwasi naa lagbara?
Iyẹn jẹ oye - atọju awọn isokuso bi awọn aaye data dipo awọn ikuna. Emi yoo pẹlu wọn ṣugbọn idojukọ lori abala ẹkọ kuku ju lilu ara mi nipa rẹ.

My 12-year-old is lashing out at me constantly and my 9-year-old keeps insisting everything is "totally fine" even when it obviously isn't. How do I handle two completely opposite coping strategies without making either of them feel like their response is wrong?

I'm specifically struggling with feeling like I'm constantly switching gears between them. Like I'll validate my older one's anger and then immediately have to act like nothing's happening with my younger one who's pretending everything's normal.
Is there a way to respond to both of them that doesn't feel like I'm being fake or inconsistent? I worry I'm coming across as two different parents.
But what if my 9-year-old sees me validating their sibling's anger and thinks I'm encouraging bad behavior? I don't want them to start acting out just to get the same attention.
What do I actually say when my 12-year-old is screaming at me and my 9-year-old is right there watching? I can't just ignore either of them in that moment.
My 12-year-old just keeps escalating when I try to set those boundaries. The calmer I get, the louder they get, like they're trying to get a reaction out of me.
Should I be explaining to my 9-year-old what's happening with their sibling or just try to shield them from it?
I think my 9-year-old already knows more than they're letting on but they won't ask questions about it. How do I open that door without forcing them to talk?
What if I'm wrong about what they need and I make things worse for one of them?
Do you think it would help if I just told them both upfront that the divorce is affecting everyone differently instead of trying to manage their reactions separately?
I keep going back and forth on whether this conversation would make things better or just add more stress to what they're already dealing with.
I think I'm overthinking this because I'm so worried about screwing up something else in their lives right now.
I'm probably making this harder than it needs to be. Maybe I should just focus on responding to whatever comes up in the moment instead of trying to plan out the perfect approach.
Yeah, that feels more manageable. I think I was getting stuck trying to fix everything at once when really I just need to show up for them.
How do I know if they need more help than I can give them though?

Yaro na mai shekaru 12 yana ta min zagi akai-akai kuma ɗana mai shekaru 9 ya ci gaba da nanata cewa komai yana "lafiya" ko da a bayyane yake. Ta yaya zan iya tafiyar da dabarun shawo kan gaba guda biyu gaba ɗaya ba tare da sanya ɗayansu ya ji kamar amsarsu ba daidai ba ce?

Ina fama musamman tare da jin kamar koyaushe ina canza kaya a tsakanin su. Kamar zan tabbatar da fushin na babba sannan in zama kamar babu abin da ke faruwa da ƙaramin nawa wanda ke yin kamar komai na al'ada ne.
Shin akwai hanyar da za a bi su duka biyun da ba ya jin kamar na karya ne ko rashin daidaituwa? Ina damuwa zan zo a matsayin iyaye biyu daban-daban.
Amma idan ɗan shekara 9 ya gan ni na tabbatar da fushin ɗan'uwansu kuma ya yi tunanin ina ƙarfafa mugun hali fa? Ba na son su fara wasan kwaikwayo don kawai su sami kulawa iri ɗaya.
Me zan ce a zahiri lokacin da ɗana ɗan shekara 12 yana kururuwa a kaina kuma ɗana mai shekara 9 yana can yana kallo? Ba zan iya yin watsi da kowannensu ba a wannan lokacin.
Yarona mai shekaru 12 yana ci gaba da haɓaka lokacin da na yi ƙoƙarin saita waɗannan iyakokin. Natsuwa na samu, sai surutu suke yi, kamar suna neman amsa min.
Shin ya kamata in yi wa ɗana mai shekara 9 bayanin abin da ke faruwa da ɗan'uwansu ko kuwa kawai in yi ƙoƙarin kare su daga hakan?
Ina tsammanin ɗana na 9 ya riga ya san fiye da yadda suke bari amma ba za su yi tambayoyi game da shi ba. Ta yaya zan bude wannan kofa ba tare da tilasta musu magana ba?
Idan na yi kuskure game da abin da suke bukata kuma na sa abubuwa su fi muni ga ɗayansu fa?
Kuna ganin zai taimaka idan na gaya musu gaba ɗaya cewa saki yana shafar kowa daban maimakon ƙoƙarin sarrafa halayensu daban?
Ina ci gaba da komawa kan ko wannan tattaunawar za ta inganta abubuwa ko kuma kawai ta ƙara damuwa ga abin da suka rigaya ke mu'amala da su.
Ina tsammanin na wuce wannan don ina matukar damuwa game da lalata wani abu a rayuwarsu a yanzu.
Wataƙila ina yin wannan wahala fiye da yadda ake buƙata. Wataƙila ya kamata in mayar da hankali kan mayar da martani ga duk abin da ya taso a wannan lokacin maimakon ƙoƙarin tsara hanyar da ta dace.
Ee, wannan yana jin ƙarin sarrafawa. Ina tsammanin an makale ina ƙoƙarin gyara komai lokaci ɗaya lokacin da gaske nake buƙatar nuna musu.
Ta yaya zan san idan suna buƙatar ƙarin taimako fiye da yadda zan iya ba su ko da yake?

Ọmọ ọdun 12 mi n kọlu mi nigbagbogbo ati pe ọmọ ọdun 9 mi n tẹriba pe ohun gbogbo jẹ “dara dara patapata” paapaa nigbati o han gbangba pe kii ṣe. Bawo ni MO ṣe mu awọn ọgbọn didamu ilodi meji patapata laisi ṣiṣe boya ninu wọn ni rilara pe idahun wọn jẹ aṣiṣe?

Mo n tiraka pataki pẹlu rilara bi Mo n yi awọn jia nigbagbogbo laarin wọn. Bii Emi yoo fọwọsi ibinu agbalagba mi ati lẹhinna lẹsẹkẹsẹ ni lati ṣe bi ohunkohun ko ṣẹlẹ pẹlu ọdọ mi ti o n dibọn ohun gbogbo jẹ deede.

Kini MO sọ ni otitọ nigbati ọmọ ọdun 12 mi n pariwo si mi ati pe ọmọ ọdun 9 mi wa nibẹ ti n wo? Emi ko le foju foju foju parẹ ọkan ninu wọn ni akoko yẹn.
Ọmọ ọdun 12 mi kan n dagba sii nigbati Mo gbiyanju lati ṣeto awọn aala yẹn. Ni ifọkanbalẹ ti Mo gba, ariwo ti wọn n pariwo, bii wọn n gbiyanju lati gba esi jade ninu mi.
Ṣe Mo yẹ ki n ṣalaye fun ọmọ ọdun 9 mi ohun ti n ṣẹlẹ pẹlu aburo wọn tabi gbiyanju lati daabobo wọn kuro lọwọ rẹ?
Mo ro pe ọmọ ọdun 9 mi ti mọ diẹ sii ju ti wọn jẹ ki wọn lọ ṣugbọn wọn kii yoo beere awọn ibeere nipa rẹ. Bawo ni MO ṣe ṣii ilẹkun yẹn laisi ipa wọn lati sọrọ?
Kini ti MO ba jẹ aṣiṣe nipa ohun ti wọn nilo ati pe Mo jẹ ki awọn nkan buru si ọkan ninu wọn?
Ṣe o ro pe yoo ṣe iranlọwọ ti MO kan sọ fun wọn mejeeji ni iwaju pe ikọsilẹ n kan gbogbo eniyan ni oriṣiriṣi dipo igbiyanju lati ṣakoso awọn aati wọn lọtọ?
Mo n tẹsiwaju ati siwaju lori boya ibaraẹnisọrọ yii yoo jẹ ki awọn nkan dara tabi o kan ṣafikun wahala diẹ sii si ohun ti wọn n ṣe tẹlẹ.
Mo ro pe mo ti n overthinking yi nitori ti mo wa ki níbi nipa dabaru soke nkankan miran ninu aye won bayi.
O ṣee ṣe Mo n jẹ ki eyi le ju ti o nilo lati jẹ. Boya Mo yẹ ki o kan idojukọ lori idahun si ohunkohun ti o wa ni akoko dipo igbiyanju lati gbero ọna pipe.
Bẹẹni, iyẹn lero diẹ sii ni iṣakoso. Mo ro pe Mo n di igbiyanju lati ṣatunṣe ohun gbogbo ni ẹẹkan nigbati Mo kan nilo lati ṣafihan fun wọn.
Bawo ni MO ṣe mọ boya wọn nilo iranlọwọ diẹ sii ju Mo le fun wọn botilẹjẹpe?

I've been sleeping through the night for the first time in months since my husband moved out, but I feel terrible about feeling better. How can I be grieving my marriage and relieved at the same time?
So this is normal then? I keep analyzing it like there's some logical explanation I'm missing, but maybe I'm overthinking it.
But what if the relief means I didn't really love him? That's what keeps eating at me - like maybe I'm discovering I was just going through the motions.
I think part of it was that I was constantly walking on eggshells around his moods. Now I can just exist without monitoring someone else's emotional temperature all the time.
Do you think I should tell him this is why I'm feeling better? Part of me wants him to understand what it was like, but I'm not sure if that's just vindictive.
I think I'm just trying to make sense of whether I was overreacting to his moods or if they were actually as disruptive as they felt. Maybe I need outside perspective on that instead.
How do I even explain what his moods were like to someone else though? It wasn't like he was screaming or throwing things - it was more subtle than that.
That barometer analogy is perfect - I was always checking the weather. I'd literally change my plans based on what I sensed when he walked through the door.
I keep wondering if I should have said something sooner instead of just adapting around it for years. Maybe things would have been different.
Maybe I'm just not cut out for the emotional work that relationships require. I mean, if checking someone's mood feels this burdensome to me, maybe I'm the problem.
So what does healthy emotional work actually look like then? Because I honestly don't know anymore.
That sounds like a completely different relationship than what I had. I don't think he ever validated my feelings - he'd just get defensive or tell me I was being too sensitive.
I think that's why I feel so guilty about the relief - because it's confirmation that things weren't actually okay, and I stayed anyway.
But how long is too long to stay? I keep thinking maybe I should have left after the first year when I noticed the pattern, not after five.
The hope for change part really gets me - I kept thinking if I could just be better at managing around his moods, things would improve.
Na yi barci cikin dare a karon farko cikin watanni tun lokacin da mijina ya ƙaura, amma ina jin tsoro don jin daɗi. Ta yaya zan kasance cikin baƙin cikin aurena kuma in sami nutsuwa a lokaci guda?
To wannan al'ada ce to? Ina ci gaba da yin nazarinsa kamar akwai wani bayani mai ma'ana da nake ɓacewa, amma watakila na yi tunanin hakan.
Amma idan kwanciyar hankali na nufin ba na son shi da gaske fa? Abin da ya ci gaba da ci a gare ni ke nan - kamar watakila na gano cewa kawai na shiga cikin motsi.
Ina tsammanin wani bangare na shi ne na kasance koyaushe ina tafiya a kan ƙwai a kusa da yanayinsa. Yanzu zan iya zama kawai ba tare da kula da yanayin zafin wani ba koyaushe.
Kina ganin ya kamata in fada masa hakan yasa naji sauki? Sashi na yana son ya fahimci yadda abin yake, amma ban tabbata ba ko wannan na rama ne kawai.
Ina tsammanin ina ƙoƙarin fahimtar ko na yi overreacting game da yanayinsa ko kuma a zahiri sun rikice kamar yadda suke ji. Wataƙila ina buƙatar hangen nesa a waje akan hakan maimakon haka.
Yaya zan ma bayyana yadda yanayinsa ya kasance ga wani ko? Ba kamar yana kururuwa ko jifa ba - ya fi wannan dabara.
Wannan kwatankwacin barometer cikakke ne - koyaushe ina duba yanayin. A zahiri zan canza tsare-tsare na bisa ga abin da na hango lokacin da ya bi ta ƙofar.
Na ci gaba da tunanin ko ya kamata in faɗi wani abu da wuri maimakon in daidaita shi tsawon shekaru. Wataƙila da abubuwa sun bambanta.
Wataƙila ba a yanke ni kawai don aikin tunanin da dangantaka ke buƙata ba. Ina nufin, idan duba yanayin wani ya ji wannan nauyi a gare ni, watakila ni ne matsalar.
Don haka menene aikin tunanin lafiya a zahiri yayi kama da haka? Domin ni gaskiya ban sani ba kuma.
Wannan yana kama da dangantaka ta bambanta da abin da nake da shi. Ba na tsammanin ya taɓa tabbatar da abin da nake ji - zai iya kare kansa ko ya gaya mani cewa na kasance mai hankali.
Ina tsammanin wannan shine dalilin da ya sa nake jin laifi game da sauƙi - saboda yana tabbatar da cewa abubuwa ba su yi kyau ba, kuma na zauna.
Amma yaushe ya daɗe da zama? Ina ci gaba da tunanin watakila ya kamata in tafi bayan shekara ta farko lokacin da na lura da tsarin, ba bayan biyar ba.
Fatan canji yana samuna sosai - Na ci gaba da tunanin idan zan iya zama mafi kyawu a cikin sarrafa yanayinsa, abubuwa za su inganta.

Mo ti sùn ni gbogbo alẹ fun igba akọkọ ni awọn oṣu lati igba ti ọkọ mi ti jade, ṣugbọn Mo lero ẹru nipa rilara dara. Báwo ni mo ṣe lè máa kó ẹ̀dùn-ọkàn bá ìgbéyàwó mi, kí n sì máa tù mí lákòókò kan náà?

Àmọ́ bí ìtura bá túmọ̀ sí pé mi ò nífẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀ gan-an ńkọ́? Iyẹn ni ohun ti n jẹun si mi - bii boya Mo n ṣe awari pe Mo kan lọ nipasẹ awọn iṣesi.
Mo ro pe apakan ninu rẹ ni pe Mo n rin nigbagbogbo lori awọn ẹyin ẹyin ni ayika awọn iṣesi rẹ. Bayi Mo le kan wa laisi abojuto iwọn otutu ẹdun ẹnikan ni gbogbo igba.
Ṣe o ro pe mo yẹ ki o sọ fun u pe eyi ni idi ti ara mi ṣe dara julọ? Apakan mi fẹ ki o loye bi o ti ri, ṣugbọn Emi ko ni idaniloju boya iyẹn jẹ igbẹsan nikan.
Mo ro pe mo kan gbiyanju lati ṣe ori ti boya Mo ti a ti overreacting si rẹ moods tabi ti o ba ti nwọn wà kosi bi disruptive bi nwọn ti ro. Boya Mo nilo irisi ita lori iyẹn dipo.
Bawo ni MO ṣe ṣalaye paapaa kini awọn iṣesi rẹ dabi si ẹlomiran botilẹjẹpe? Ko dabi pe o n pariwo tabi ju awọn nkan - o jẹ arekereke ju iyẹn lọ.
Apejuwe barometer yẹn jẹ pipe - Mo n ṣayẹwo oju ojo nigbagbogbo. Emi yoo yi awọn eto mi gangan da lori ohun ti Mo ni oye nigbati o rin nipasẹ ẹnu-ọna.
Mo n ṣe iyalẹnu boya MO yẹ ki o ti sọ nkan kan laipẹ dipo ti o kan mu ni ayika rẹ fun awọn ọdun. Boya ohun yoo ti yatọ.
Boya Emi ko kan ge kuro fun iṣẹ ẹdun ti awọn ibatan nilo. Mo tumọ si, ti iṣayẹwo iṣesi ẹnikan ba ni imọlara ẹru yii si mi, boya Emi ni iṣoro naa.
Nitorinaa kini iṣẹ ẹdun ti ilera dabi gangan lẹhinna? Nitori emi nitootọ ko mọ mọ.
Ti o ba ndun bi a patapata ti o yatọ ibasepo ju ohun ti mo ti ní. Emi ko ro pe o lailai ti f'aṣẹ si mi ikunsinu - o yoo kan gba igbeja tabi so fun mi Mo ti a ti jije ju kókó.
Mo ro pe idi niyi ti Mo fi lero pe o jẹbi nipa iderun - nitori pe o jẹ idaniloju pe awọn nkan ko dara, ati pe Mo duro lonakona.
Ṣugbọn bi o gun gun ju lati duro? Mo n ronu boya MO yẹ ki o lọ lẹhin ọdun akọkọ nigbati Mo ṣe akiyesi apẹrẹ, kii ṣe lẹhin marun.
Ireti fun apakan iyipada gba mi gaan - Mo tẹsiwaju ni ironu ti MO ba le dara julọ ni iṣakoso ni ayika awọn iṣesi rẹ, awọn nkan yoo dara si.

Look, a mutual friend told me my ex said I was "emotionally unavailable" during our marriage, and now I can't stop crafting the perfect response to tear that argument apart. How do I get this out of my head when I know responding would just make everything worse?

The thing is, I keep running through all the evidence that proves them wrong - like how I was the one who suggested couples therapy, or how I initiated most of our serious conversations. Is there a way to just dump all these thoughts somewhere so they stop cycling in my head?
I tried the brain dump thing but I keep wanting to go back and read what I wrote to see if I missed any good counterarguments. Should I just delete it right after writing?
Okay but what if I'm actually right and she really was the emotionally unavailable one? How do I deal with feeling like I'm just accepting an unfair narrative about myself?
But if I don't defend myself, doesn't that basically confirm their version of events to everyone who hears it? I feel like my silence is just letting them win.
What if my ex is saying this stuff to people we both work with though? This could actually affect my reputation professionally.
I work in consulting and reputation is everything here - people literally hire us based on trust and interpersonal skills. How do I address this without looking defensive or creating more drama?
Should I reach out to the mutual friend who told me about this to get more details about what exactly was said and in what context?
The mutual friend is also someone I work with occasionally on projects, so this isn't just personal drama anymore - they probably think less of me professionally too now.
What if I just casually mention in conversation with this colleague that my ex and I had different communication styles, without making it seem like I'm responding to anything specific?
I keep drafting that perfect casual comment in my head but then second-guessing whether it sounds too rehearsed or defensive. How do I make it sound natural?
How much time should I let pass before bringing this up? I don't want it to seem like I just heard about what my ex said.

You know what, forget the subtle approach. I think I need to just focus on doing my job well and let my work speak for itself. But how do I stop my brain from constantly rehearsing these conversations that will never happen?
I'm already doing the journaling thing but I keep going back to read what I wrote and it just feeds the cycle again. Should I try writing it somewhere I can't access later?

How do I tell the difference between my gut instinct and just being defensive from the marriage? I've been analyzing this for weeks and keep going in circles.

Tsohona ya ci gaba da yin saƙo game da "zama abokai" kuma yana ba da shawarar mu ɗauki kofi don "magana ta al'amura." Ba zan iya girgiza jin wannan wata hanya ce kawai a gare su su ci gaba da shiga cikin rayuwata ba, amma ban tabbata ba ko ina zama mai ban tsoro.
Ta yaya zan bambanta tsakanin ilhami na hanji da kuma kawai na karewa daga aure? Na yi nazarin wannan tsawon makonni kuma na ci gaba da tafiya cikin da'ira.
Wadanne takamaiman abubuwa ne ya kamata in lura da yadda suke amsa iyakoki? Ina buƙatar takamaiman misalai na jajayen tutoci tare da halayen aboki na yau da kullun.
Wannan yana taimakawa. Na ce musu ina bukatar sarari kuma suka amsa da "Na fahimta, amma ina ganin zai yi kyau mu duka mu rufe." Shin ya kamata in damu da sashin "amma"?
Shin zan amsa kwata-kwata ko kawai in yi watsi da saƙon? Na damu cewa rashin mayar da martani zai sa al'amura su yi muni, amma amsawa na ji kamar ina buɗe ƙofar da nake so in rufe.

Ina tsammanin zan aiko da gajeren amsa. Wani abu kamar "Na fahimci kuna son rufewa, amma ban shirya don wannan tattaunawar ba. Ina buƙatar ƙarin lokaci." Shin hakan yana da ƙarfi sosai ba tare da kaushi ba?
Har yaushe zan jira kafin in yi la'akari da martanin su don yin hukunci ko suna mutunta iyaka? Ba na son yin nazari sosai amma kuma ba na so in rasa fitattun jajayen tutoci.
Suka amsa cikin sa'a guda suna cewa "Tabbas, ɗauki duk lokacin da kuke buƙata. Kawai ku sani ina nan lokacin da kuka shirya." Shin hakan yana da sha'awar ko ina karantawa?
Me zai faru idan sun sake fara kai hari a cikin 'yan kwanaki ko makonni? Ina bukatan tsarin yadda zan bi don kada a kama ni a hankali in karasa amsa ta hanyar da zan yi nadama.
Ta yaya zan iya sanin ko a zahiri na warke ko kuma kawai na guje wa mu'amala da abubuwa? Ina ci gaba da zato na biyu ko ɗaukar sarari shine matakin da ya dace ko kuma idan na gudu ne kawai.

Ina tsammanin ina wani wuri a tsakiya. Tabbas ina sarrafa motsin rai amma kuma ina amfani da aiki don guje wa ma'amala da abubuwa masu wahala. Shin hakan na al'ada ne ko wani abu da nake buƙatar magance?

Shin zan yi ƙoƙari na keɓe takamaiman lokuta don yin tunani game da abubuwan kisan aure, ko zai fi kyau in bar motsin rai ya taso a zahiri? Ina jin kamar ina buƙatar wani tsari amma ba na son tilasta shi.
Idan lokacin sarrafawa kawai ya juya ya zama ruminating fa? Ina cikin damuwa zan makale a madaukai na nazarin duk abin da ya faru ba daidai ba maimakon a zahiri ci gaba.
Ta yaya zan san lokacin da na shirya don yin wannan tattaunawar rufewa da tsohona? Ba na so in yi gaggawar shi amma kuma ba na so in guje shi har abada.
Na damu cewa yin tattaunawar rufewa kawai zai buɗe tsoffin raunuka ko sanya ni shakkar shawarar da na yanke na barin. Shin zai yiwu a rufe ba tare da yin magana da su a zahiri ba?

Mi Mofi ntọju nkọ ọrọ nipa "duro ọrẹ" ati ni iyanju a ja kofi lati "soro nipasẹ ohun." Emi ko le mì rilara pe eyi jẹ ọna miiran fun wọn lati duro ni ipa ninu igbesi aye mi, ṣugbọn Emi ko ni idaniloju boya Mo jẹ paranoid.

Awọn nkan pato wo ni MO yẹ ki n ṣọna fun bi wọn ṣe dahun si awọn aala? Mo nilo awọn apẹẹrẹ nja ti awọn asia pupa dipo ihuwasi ọrẹ deede.

Ṣe Mo yẹ ki o dahun rara tabi kan foju pa ifiranṣẹ naa? Mo ṣe aniyan pe ko dahun yoo jẹ ki awọn nkan buru si, ṣugbọn idahun dabi pe Mo n ṣii ilẹkun ti Mo fẹ lati pa.

Igba melo ni MO yẹ ki n duro ṣaaju ki o to gbero esi wọn lati ṣe idajọ boya wọn bọwọ fun ala? Emi ko fẹ lati overanalyze sugbon Emi tun ko ba fẹ lati padanu han pupa awọn asia.
Wọn dahun laarin wakati kan wipe "Dajudaju, gba gbogbo akoko ti o nilo. Kan mọ pe Mo wa nibi nigbati o ba ṣetan." Ṣe iyẹn ni itara pupọ tabi Mo n ka sinu rẹ?
Bí wọ́n bá tún bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í dé ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn ọjọ́ mélòó kan tàbí ọ̀sẹ̀ mélòó kan ńkọ́? Mo nilo eto kan fun bi o ṣe le ṣe mu iyẹn ki Emi ko ba wa ni iṣọra ati pari ni idahun ni ọna ti Emi yoo kabamọ.
Bawo ni MO ṣe mọ boya Mo n mu iwosan gaan tabi o kan yago fun ṣiṣe pẹlu awọn nkan? Mo máa ń sọ̀rọ̀ lẹ́ẹ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan bóyá gbígba àyè ni ìṣísẹ̀ tó tọ́ tàbí tí mo bá ń sá lọ.
Mo ro pe mo wa ibikan ni aarin. Dajudaju Mo n ṣakoso awọn ẹdun ṣugbọn tun nlo iṣẹ lati yago fun ṣiṣe pẹlu nkan ti o le. Ṣe iyẹn deede tabi nkan ti Mo nilo lati koju?
Ṣe Mo yẹ ki n gbiyanju lati ya awọn akoko kan pato sọtọ lati ronu nipa nkan ikọsilẹ, tabi o dara julọ lati jẹ ki awọn ẹdun wa ni ara bi? Mo lero pe Mo nilo eto diẹ ṣugbọn Emi ko fẹ fi ipa mu u.
Ohun ti o ba processing akoko kan wa sinu ruminating? Mo ni aniyan Emi yoo di ni awọn iyipo ti itupalẹ ohun gbogbo ti o jẹ aṣiṣe dipo gbigbe siwaju.
Bawo ni MO ṣe mọ nigbati Mo ṣetan lati ni ibaraẹnisọrọ pipade yẹn pẹlu iṣaaju mi? Emi ko fẹ lati yara ṣugbọn emi ko fẹ lati yago fun lailai.
Mo ṣe aniyan pe nini ibaraẹnisọrọ pipade kan yoo ṣii awọn ọgbẹ atijọ tabi jẹ ki n ṣiyemeji ipinnu mi lati lọ kuro. Ṣe o ṣee ṣe lati ni pipade lai ba wọn sọrọ ni otitọ?

What if she starts asking about specific things we might not be able to afford anymore, like her dance classes or our summer vacation?

I just want something I can do without having to think about steps or remember techniques. Something that happens automatically when my mind starts spiraling.

Ina ci gaba da tafiyar da al'amuran kuɗi a kaina maimakon in mai da hankali kan yadda yarana ke tafiyar da kisan aure. Ta yaya zan daina jin kamar mugun iyaye don damuwa da kuɗi fiye da yanayin tunanin su?

Damuwar akai-akai yana da ma'ana ko da yake - idan ba zan iya ba su kudi ba, ta yaya zan iya kula da bukatun tunaninsu? Ina buƙatar hanyoyi masu amfani don raba waɗannan damuwa lokacin da suke jin haɗin gwiwa sosai.

Na gwada tsarin lokacin damuwa da aka keɓe amma har yanzu tunanin kuɗi yana zub da jini lokacin da nake tare da yarana. Waɗanne takamaiman dabaru zan iya amfani da su a lokacin da waɗannan tunanin suka kutsa cikin lokacin iyali?

Lokacin da ’yar shekara 8 ta tambaye ni dalilin da ya sa nake ganin ya ɗauke ni hankali, ta yaya zan yi bayani ba tare da sanya mata ta ji kamar ba ta da mahimmanci ko kuma dora ta da matsalolin manya?
Wannan yana da kyau amma ina cikin damuwa za ta yi tambayoyi masu biyo baya ban shirya ba. Idan ta tambaya musamman menene "kayan girma" ko kuma tana son sanin ko za mu sami isassun kuɗi fa?
Yaya zan yi da shi lokacin da ta ci gaba da turawa don cikakkun bayanai bayan na yi ƙoƙarin turawa? Tana da tsayin daka lokacin da ta ji na rike wani abu.
Ta tambayeni jiya ko za mu zama talakawa ne gaba daya na daskare. Na ce "a'a" amma ta iya cewa ban tabbata ba. Ta yaya zan murmure daga lokacin kuma in sake gina amana?
Ina cikin damuwa idan na sake kawowa zan kara dagula lamarin ko kuma in dasa mata damuwa a kai. Shin zan jira ta ta sake tambaya ko in yi magana a hankali?
Idan ta fara tambaya game da takamaiman abubuwan da ba za mu iya ba kuma, kamar azuzuwan raye-rayenta ko hutunmu na bazara fa?
Ina ci gaba da bala'i game da yadda ta ji haushina daga baya don barin abubuwan da take so. Ta yaya zan iya sarrafa laifina yayin da har yanzu nake yanke shawarar kuɗi masu mahimmanci?

Wani lokaci nakan kama kaina ina lissafin biyan kuɗin tallafin yara a lokacin labarin mu na barci. Shin akwai wata hanya ta horar da kwakwalwata don rarraba mafi kyau don kada waɗannan tunanin su mamaye lokutanmu na musamman?

Shin za ku iya ba ni wata takamaiman dabarar da zan iya amfani da ita a daidai lokacin da nake karanta mata kuma hankalina ya fara lissafin lambobi? Wani abu mai sauki zan iya yi ba tare da ta lura ba.
Hakan yana da taimako amma ina cikin damuwa da in bi duk matakai biyar ba tare da rasa labarin ba. Akwai abin da ya fi guntu zan iya yi?
Idan ma hakan yana jin kamar ƙoƙarin tunani da yawa lokacin da na riga na yi ƙoƙarin mai da hankali kan karatu da kasancewa tare da ita fa?
Ina son wani abu da zan iya yi ba tare da yin tunani game da matakai ko tuna dabaru ba. Wani abu da ke faruwa ta atomatik lokacin da hankalina ya fara karkata.
Mo tọju ṣiṣe awọn oju iṣẹlẹ inawo ni ori mi dipo idojukọ lori bii awọn ọmọ mi ṣe n ṣakoso ikọsilẹ naa. Bawo ni MO ṣe da rilara bi obi ti o buruju fun iṣoro diẹ sii nipa owo ju ipo ẹdun wọn lọ?

Ibalẹ nigbagbogbo jẹ oye botilẹjẹpe - ti Emi ko ba le pese fun wọn ni inawo, bawo ni MO ṣe le ṣe abojuto awọn iwulo ẹdun wọn? Mo nilo awọn ọna ti o wulo lati ya awọn aniyan wọnyi sọtọ nigbati wọn ba ni imọlara ibaraenisepo.
Mo ti gbiyanju ọna akoko aibalẹ ti a pinnu ṣugbọn awọn ero inawo ṣi nṣan ẹjẹ nigbati Mo wa pẹlu awọn ọmọ mi. Awọn ilana pato wo ni MO le lo ni akoko ti awọn ironu wọnyẹn wọ inu akoko idile?
Nigbati ọmọ ọdun 8 mi beere idi ti Mo fi dabi ẹni ti o ni idamu, bawo ni MO ṣe ṣe alaye lai jẹ ki o lero bi ko ṣe pataki tabi di ẹru rẹ pẹlu awọn iṣoro agbalagba?
Iyẹn dun dara ṣugbọn Mo ni aibalẹ pe yoo beere awọn ibeere atẹle Emi ko murasilẹ fun. Kini ti o ba beere ni pataki kini “nkan ti o dagba” jẹ tabi fẹ lati mọ boya a yoo ni owo to?
Bawo ni MO ṣe ṣe mu nigbati o tẹsiwaju titari fun awọn alaye lẹhin Mo ti gbiyanju atunṣe? O jẹ itẹramọṣẹ lẹwa nigbati o ni imọran pe Mo n di nkan mu.
O beere lọwọ mi ni ana boya a yoo jẹ talaka ati pe Mo di didi patapata. Mo kan sọ “rara” ṣugbọn o le sọ fun mi ko da mi loju. Bawo ni MO ṣe gba pada lati akoko yẹn ati tun igbẹkẹle ṣe?
Mo wa níbi wipe ti o ba ti mo ti mu soke lẹẹkansi Emi yoo kan ṣe awọn ti o buru tabi gbìn diẹ aniyan si ori rẹ. Ṣe Mo yẹ ki o duro fun u lati beere lẹẹkansi tabi koju rẹ ni itara bi?
Kini ti o ba bẹrẹ si beere nipa awọn ohun kan pato ti a le ma ni anfani lati san mọ, bii awọn kilasi ijó tabi isinmi igba ooru wa?
Mo ti pa catastrophizing nipa resensing mi nigbamii fun nini lati fi soke ohun ti o fẹràn. Bawo ni MO ṣe ṣakoso ẹbi ti ara mi lakoko ti o n ṣe awọn ipinnu inawo pataki?

Nigba miiran Mo mu ara mi ni ọpọlọ ti n ṣe iṣiro awọn sisanwo atilẹyin ọmọ lakoko awọn itan akoko ibusun wa. Njẹ ọna kan wa lati ṣe ikẹkọ ọpọlọ mi lati ṣe ipin ti o dara julọ ki awọn ero wọnyi maṣe jagun awọn akoko pataki wa?
Ṣe o le fun mi ni ilana kan pato ti MO le lo ni akoko ti Mo n kawe si ati pe ọkan mi bẹrẹ iṣiro awọn nọmba? Nkankan ti o rọrun Mo le ṣe laisi akiyesi rẹ.
Iyẹn ṣe iranlọwọ ṣugbọn Mo ni aniyan nipa lilọ nipasẹ gbogbo awọn igbesẹ marun laisi sisọnu orin itan naa. Njẹ nkan ti o kuru ti MO le ṣe?
Kini ti o ba jẹ pe paapaa iyẹn kan lara bi igbiyanju ọpọlọ pupọ nigbati Mo n gbiyanju tẹlẹ si idojukọ lori kika ati wiwa pẹlu rẹ?
Mo kan fẹ nkan ti MO le ṣe laisi nini lati ronu nipa awọn igbesẹ tabi ranti awọn ilana. Nkankan ti o ṣẹlẹ laifọwọyi nigbati ọkan mi bẹrẹ spiraling.
I had this dream last night where my ex and I were just normal again, like nothing had happened. Why did waking up hit me so hard when I thought I was past all this?

But I analyze everything else so logically - why can't I just process this the same way? There has to be some kind of framework or method to work through why a stupid dream is derailing me when I've been handling the actual divorce proceedings just fine.
What specific elements should I be looking for when I analyze the dream symbolically? I need concrete steps, not just "explore the symbolism."

The setting was our old kitchen, and we were just making breakfast together like we used to on weekends. How do I interpret what that specific routine means without just saying "I miss the relationship"?

The breakfast was just scrambled eggs and toast - nothing fancy. But what's bothering me is that in the dream everything felt so effortless, like we never had any of the problems that led to the divorce.

That's exactly it - the effortlessness. In reality, even making breakfast became a minefield because we'd argue about everything from who bought the wrong bread to whose turn it was to clean up. How do I separate wanting that feeling of ease from wanting the actual person back?
So if I can identify that I want ease and lack of conflict, how do I actually create that for myself without another person? I can't exactly have breakfast conversations with myself.

I already do most of those things - meditation, routines, boundaries. But none of that recreates the specific feeling of shared ease with another person. Are you saying I just have to accept that I can't have that right now?

I'm not ready for new connections yet, and telling me to "be open to the unexpected" doesn't solve the fact that I'm missing something I can't replace right now. What do I actually do with this longing when practical solutions don't address it?
Stop giving me lists of things to try. I'm asking what to do when you're stuck with a feeling that has no solution - when you just have to sit with longing that can't be fixed or processed away.
How long does this usually last?
I need a timeframe. Weeks? Months? A year? I don't want platitudes about healing not being linear.
That's helpful. So I'm looking at potentially feeling this way for most of the next year.
What if it's not better in a year?
Na yi wannan mafarkin jiya da daddare inda ni da tsohona muka sake zama al'ada, kamar babu abin da ya faru. Me yasa tashina ya buge ni da karfi lokacin da na yi tunanin na wuce duk wannan?

Amma ina nazarin duk wani abu da hankali - me yasa ba zan iya aiwatar da wannan hanya ɗaya ba? Dole ne a sami wani nau'i na tsari ko hanyar da za a yi aiki ta hanyar dalilin da yasa mafarkin wawa ke lalata ni yayin da na yi amfani da ainihin shari'ar kisan aure da kyau.
Wadanne takamaiman abubuwa zan nema lokacin da na bincika mafarkin a alamance? Ina buƙatar takamaiman matakai, ba kawai "binciko alamar alama ba."

Saitin shine tsohon kicin din mu, kawai muna yin breakfast tare kamar yadda muka saba yi a karshen mako. Ta yaya zan fassara abin da takamaiman na yau da kullun ke nufi ba tare da cewa "Na rasa dangantakar ba"?

Abincin karin kumallo ya kasance kawai ƙwai da gasa - ba abin zato ba. Amma abin da ke daure min kai shi ne, a cikin mafarki komai na ji kamar ba mu da wahala, kamar ba mu taba samun wata matsala da ta kai ga rabuwar aure ba.

Wannan shi ne daidai - rashin ƙoƙari. A hakikanin gaskiya, ko yin karin kumallo ya zama filin hakowa domin za mu yi gardama game da duk wani abu daga wanda ya sayi burodin da ba daidai ba zuwa wanda zai yi sharewa. Ta yaya zan raba son wannan jin daɗi da son ainihin mutumin baya?
Don haka idan zan iya gane cewa ina son sauƙi da rashin rikici, ta yaya zan ƙirƙiri wannan don kaina ba tare da wani mutum ba? Ba zan iya ainihin tattaunawar karin kumallo da kaina ba.

Wannan yana da ma'ana. Don haka idan na lura ina gaggawar sayar da gidan kuma likitana ya tambaye ni yadda nake ji game da shi, maimakon kawai in ce "yana da hankali game da kudi," in yi ƙoƙari in gano abin da motsin rai ke motsa wannan gaggawa?

To amma fa idan na gane cewa ina tsoron abubuwan da ke cikin gidan, sannan likitana yana so ya shafe zama uku yana magana game da takamaiman abubuwan tunawa maimakon ya taimake ni yanke shawarar ko zan sayar ko a'a?
Ta yaya zan gaya mata ina bukatan yanke shawarar gidan nan da makonni biyu masu zuwa ba tare da jin kamar ba ni da haƙuri ko watsi da tsarin jiyya?

Dakata, wani abu guda - menene idan har yanzu tana ƙoƙarin tona ra'ayina game da gidan maimakon ta taimake ni in yanke shawara na gaske?

Kun yi gaskiya, tabbas yakamata in fara magana da ita. Na dai ci gaba da ajiyewa ne saboda ban san yadda zan kawo shi ba ba tare da ban mamaki ba.
Idan na tura mata text maimakon? Hakan na iya zama da sauƙi fiye da yin shi fuska da fuska.
Ina tsammanin kun yi daidai da yin shi a cikin mutum. Ina cikin damuwa kawai zan daskare ko in fara racing kuma in mai da shi kamar na sake yin uzuri.
Watakila kawai in yi ƙoƙari in matsawa in tafi wurin bikin wannan lokaci guda. Idan zan iya yin sau ɗaya, watakila zai sami sauƙi.
Ina tsammanin na wuce wannan duka. Watakila kowa yakan soke tsare-tsare wani lokaci kuma ina sanya shi cikin babbar yarjejeniya fiye da yadda yake a zahiri.
Amma idan ta kasance tana jin haushi kuma na daɗa yin ta da rashin magance ta fa? Yanzu ina ji kamar na daɗe da jira don in faɗi wani abu.
Kun san me, ina tsammanin zan gaya mata ba ni da lafiya a karshen mako kuma in magance wannan daga baya. Aƙalla hakan yana sayan lokaci don gano abin da zan faɗa.
Lafiya, zan yi mata magana a daren nan idan ta dawo daga aji. Ina fatan ban gama lalata wannan ba kuma in rasa mutumin da yake magana da ni a nan.

Mo sọ fun ẹnikeji mi pe Emi yoo lọ si ayẹyẹ yii pẹlu rẹ ni ipari ipari yii ṣugbọn Mo n ronu tẹlẹ ti awọn awawi lati gba beeli. Kii ṣe adehun nla paapaa, diẹ ninu awọn eniyan kan lati ile ibugbe wa ti n gbe jade.

Mo gboju pe MO sọ bẹẹni nitori Emi ko fẹ lati dabi ẹni ti o lodi si awujọ, ṣugbọn lẹhinna nigbati akoko ba de Mo kan ni aniyan pupọ nipa gbogbo ọrọ kekere ati Emi ko mọ kini lati sọ. Boya o ni ko kosi ti kekere ti a ti yio se.

Ti o ba ti o bar Mo n kan jije flaky tilẹ? Mo ti fagilee ni ọpọlọpọ igba ti o le ma gba mi gbọ nigbati mo gbiyanju lati ṣalaye.
Mo kan bẹru Emi yoo padanu ọrẹ kan ṣoṣo ti Mo ti ṣe ni ọdun yii. Kini ti o ba n ṣalaye eyi mu ki awọn nkan buru si laarin wa?
Ṣe Mo yẹ ki n lọ si ayẹyẹ yii ni akọkọ lati jẹri pe MO le tẹle nipasẹ, tabi ni ibaraẹnisọrọ ṣaaju ki o mọ idi ti Mo ti jẹ alaburuku?
O tọ, Mo yẹ ki o sọrọ pẹlu rẹ akọkọ. Mo ti o kan pa fifi o si pa nitori Emi ko mo bi lati mu o soke lai o jije isokuso.
Ohun ti o ba ti mo ti o kan fi rẹ a ọrọ dipo? Iyẹn le rọrun ju ṣiṣe ni ojukoju.
Mo gboju pe o tọ nipa ṣiṣe ni eniyan. Mo kan ni aniyan Emi yoo di soke tabi bẹrẹ rambling ati jẹ ki o dun bi Mo tun n ṣe awawi lẹẹkansi.
Boya Mo yẹ ki o kan gbiyanju lati Titari nipasẹ ati lọ si ayẹyẹ ni akoko kan. Ti MO ba le ṣe lẹẹkan, boya yoo rọrun.
Mo ro pe Mo n overthinking yi gbogbo ohun. Boya gbogbo eniyan fagile awọn ero nigbakan ati pe Mo n ṣe si adehun nla ju ti o jẹ gangan.
Ṣugbọn kini ti o ba jẹ pe o binu nitootọ ati pe Mo kan ti jẹ ki o buru si nipa ko koju rẹ? Bayi Mo lero bi Mo ti sọ duro gun ju lati sọ ohunkohun.
O mọ kini, Mo ro pe Emi yoo kan sọ fun u pe Mo ṣaisan ni ipari ipari yii ati ṣe pẹlu eyi nigbamii. Ni o kere ti o ra mi diẹ ninu awọn akoko lati ro ero ohun ti lati sọ.
O dara, Emi yoo ba a sọrọ ni alẹ oni nigbati o ba pada lati kilasi. Mo lero o kan Emi ko patapata idotin yi si oke ati awọn padanu awọn nikan ni eniyan ti o kosi sọrọ si mi nibi.

I went to my professor's office hours for the first time yesterday and it actually went fine, but then I spent like three hours afterwards replaying every single thing I said and cringing. Why is the overthinking part so much worse than the actual conversation?

I mean, I guess it went okay because my professor answered my questions and didn't seem annoyed or anything. But I keep thinking about how I said "um" too much and how I probably came across as unprepared even though I had my questions written down.
I keep telling myself it wasn't that bad but then my brain just goes "but what if he thinks I'm stupid now?" Is there a way to stop that loop from happening?
But like, what if I'm wrong about it going fine? What if I'm just really bad at reading social cues and he was actually annoyed the whole time but being polite?
Okay but honestly, this isn't just about office hours. I do this after literally every social interaction and it's exhausting.
Is there like a time limit I should set for how long I'm allowed to think about it? Because three hours seems excessive even to me.
What should I do when I catch myself going over the time limit though? Because knowing me, I'll probably just beat myself up for not being able to stick to it.
Actually no, I think I'm making this harder than it is. Maybe I should just accept that I'm going to overthink and stop trying to control it so much.
I'm just tired of feeling like I'm broken or weird for doing this when apparently everyone overthinks sometimes.
I guess what bugs me is that other people seem to just move on after conversations but I get stuck replaying them for hours.
Do you think there's something fundamentally different about people who overthink versus people who don't, or is it just learned behavior that can be changed?
I think I just want to feel normal for once without having to work so hard at managing my brain all the time.
Can therapy actually help with this or is it just going to be more work I have to do on myself?
But what if I talk to a therapist and they confirm that I actually am as socially awkward as I think I am?
I keep going back and forth on whether I actually need therapy or if I'm just being dramatic about normal college stress.

Na je ofishin farfesa na a karon farko jiya kuma abin ya yi kyau, amma sai na yi kamar sa'o'i uku bayan haka ina sake kunna duk wani abu da na fada. Me ya sa bangaren da ya wuce gona da iri ya fi muni fiye da ainihin zance?

Ina nufin, ina tsammanin ya yi kyau saboda farfesa ya amsa tambayoyina kuma bai ji haushi ko wani abu ba. Amma na ci gaba da tunanin yadda na ce "um" da yawa da kuma yadda na gamu da rashin shiri duk da cewa na rubuta tambayoyina.
Na ci gaba da fada wa kaina cewa ba haka ba ne amma sai kwakwalwata ta tafi "amma idan ya yi tunanin ni wawa ne yanzu?" Shin akwai hanyar da za a hana wannan madauki daga faruwa?
Amma kamar, idan na yi kuskure game da tafiya lafiya fa? Me zai faru idan na kasance da gaske mugun karanta abubuwan zamantakewa kuma a zahiri yana jin haushin duk lokacin amma yana da ladabi?
To amma gaskiya, wannan ba kusan lokutan ofis bane kawai. Ina yin wannan bayan a zahiri kowane hulɗar zamantakewa kuma yana da gajiya.
Shin akwai kamar ƙayyadaddun lokaci da ya kamata in saita na tsawon lokacin da aka ba ni damar yin tunani akai? Domin sa'o'i uku kamar sun wuce gona da iri ko a gare ni.
Menene ya kamata in yi idan na kama kaina na wuce iyakacin lokaci ko? Domin sanina, tabbas zan yi wa kaina dukan tsiya don ba zan iya tsayawa ba.
A gaskiya a'a, ina tsammanin ina yin wannan wahala fiye da yadda yake. Watakila kawai in yarda cewa zan wuce tunani kuma in daina ƙoƙarin sarrafa shi sosai.
Ni kawai na gaji da jin kamar na karye ko ban mamaki don yin wannan lokacin da alama kowa ya wuce tunanin wani lokaci.
Ina tsammanin abin da ke damun ni shi ne cewa wasu mutane suna neman ci gaba ne kawai bayan tattaunawa amma na makale ina sake kunna su na sa'o'i.
Kuna tsammanin akwai wani abu da ya bambanta game da mutanen da suka wuce gona da iri da mutanen da ba su yi ba, ko kuwa halin koyo ne kawai za a iya canza?
Ina tsammanin ina so in ji al'ada sau ɗaya ba tare da yin aiki tuƙuru ba wajen sarrafa kwakwalwata koyaushe.
Shin maganin zai iya taimakawa da wannan ko kuwa zai zama ƙarin aikin da zan yi a kaina?
Amma idan na yi magana da mai ilimin hanyoyin kwantar da hankali kuma sun tabbatar da cewa ni a zahiri na kasance mai ban sha'awa kamar yadda nake tsammani ni?
Ina ci gaba da komowa akan ko a zahiri ina buƙatar magani ko kuma idan na kasance mai ban mamaki game da damuwa na kwaleji na yau da kullun.

Mo lọ si awọn wakati ọfiisi ọjọgbọn mi fun igba akọkọ lana ati pe o dara gaan, ṣugbọn lẹhinna Mo lo bii wakati mẹta lẹhinna tun ṣe gbogbo ohun kan ti Mo sọ ati criing. Kilode ti abala ironu ti o buru pupọ ju ibaraẹnisọrọ gangan lọ?

Mo tumọ si, Mo gboju pe o dara nitori ọjọgbọn mi dahun awọn ibeere mi ati pe ko dabi ẹni pe o binu tabi ohunkohun. Àmọ́ mo máa ń ronú nípa bí mo ṣe sọ “um” tó pọ̀ ju àti báwo ni mo ṣe lè rí bí mi ò tíì múra sílẹ̀ bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé mo kọ àwọn ìbéèrè mi sílẹ̀.
Mo n sọ fun ara mi pe ko buru bẹ ṣugbọn lẹhinna ọpọlọ mi kan lọ “ṣugbọn kini ti o ba ro pe aṣiwere ni mi ni bayi?” Njẹ ọna kan wa lati da lupu yẹn duro lati ṣẹlẹ?
Ṣugbọn bii, kini ti MO ba jẹ aṣiṣe nipa lilọ dara? Kini ti Mo ba buru gaan ni kika awọn ifẹnukonu awujọ ati pe o binu nitootọ ni gbogbo akoko ṣugbọn jijẹ?
O dara ṣugbọn nitootọ, eyi kii ṣe nipa awọn wakati ọfiisi nikan. Mo ṣe eyi lẹhin itumọ ọrọ gangan gbogbo ibaraenisepo awujọ ati pe o rẹwẹsi.
Ṣe o dabi opin akoko ti MO yẹ ki o ṣeto fun igba melo ni MO gba mi laaye lati ronu nipa rẹ bi? Nitoripe wakati mẹta dabi ẹni pe o pọju paapaa fun mi.
Kini MO yẹ ki n ṣe nigbati Mo ba gba ara mi ni lilọ lori opin akoko botilẹjẹpe? Nitori ti o mọ mi, Emi yoo jasi kan lu ara mi nitori ko ni anfani lati faramọ.
Lootọ rara, Mo ro pe Mo n jẹ ki eyi le ju ti o lọ. Boya Mo yẹ ki o kan gba pe Emi yoo ronu pupọ ati dawọ igbiyanju lati ṣakoso rẹ pupọ.
Mo wa o kan bani o ti rilara bi mo ti wa dà tabi isokuso fun a ṣe eyi nigba ti nkqwe gbogbo eniyan overthinks ma.
Mo gboju pe kini awọn idun mi ni pe awọn eniyan miiran dabi pe wọn kan tẹsiwaju lẹhin awọn ibaraẹnisọrọ ṣugbọn Mo di atunwi wọn fun awọn wakati.
Ṣe o ro pe o wa ni nkankan taa o yatọ nipa awọn eniyan ti o overthion dipo awọn eniyan ti o ko, tabi o kan eko ihuwasi ti o le wa ni yipada?
Mo ro pe Mo kan fẹ lati ni rilara deede fun ẹẹkan laisi nini lati ṣiṣẹ takuntakun ni ṣiṣakoso ọpọlọ mi ni gbogbo igba.
Njẹ itọju ailera le ṣe iranlọwọ gangan pẹlu eyi tabi o kan yoo jẹ iṣẹ diẹ sii ti Mo ni lati ṣe lori ara mi?
Ṣugbọn kini ti MO ba sọrọ si oniwosan aisan kan ati pe wọn jẹrisi pe Emi ni gangan bi aibikita lawujọ bi Mo ṣe ro pe emi jẹ?
Mo tẹsiwaju siwaju ati siwaju lori boya Mo nilo itọju ailera gangan tabi ti MO ba kan jẹ iyalẹnu nipa aapọn kọlẹji deede.
I've been eating lunch in my car every day instead of going to the dining hall. I tell myself it's better this way but I think I'm just making excuses.
Yeah, it's definitely the social anxiety thing. The dining hall is just so loud and crowded and I never know where to sit or who to sit with.
I tried going during off-peak hours but even when it's less crowded I still feel like everyone is staring at me when I walk in alone.
I know logically that people probably aren't looking at me but it doesn't matter - my heart still starts racing the second I walk through those doors.
The breathing thing helps a little but by the time I'm actually in there my mind goes completely blank and I just grab whatever food is closest and leave as fast as possible.
Actually, I think this is worse than I've been admitting to myself. I haven't had a real conversation with anyone except my roommate in like three weeks.
I keep thinking I should join something but then I imagine walking into a room full of strangers and I just can't do it.

I'm scared that if I post my photos online people will think they're terrible since I'm so out of practice.
You know what, maybe I should just start by taking a few photos around campus and see how it feels. I don't have to show anyone yet.

Kullum ina cin abincin rana a motata maimakon in je wurin cin abinci. Ina gaya wa kaina cewa ya fi kyau ta wannan hanyar amma ina tsammanin zan ba da uzuri ne kawai.
Ee, tabbas abin damuwa ne na zamantakewa. Dining hall din ne kawai yake da hayaniya da cunkoson jama'a ban san inda zan zauna ba balle wanda zan zauna.
Na yi ƙoƙarin tafiya cikin sa'o'i marasa ƙarfi amma ko da ba cunkoso ba har yanzu ina jin kamar kowa yana kallona lokacin da na shiga ni kaɗai.
Na san a hankali cewa mutane ba sa kallona amma ba kome ba - har yanzu zuciyata ta fara tsere a lokacin da na bi ta waɗannan kofofin.
Abun numfashi yana taimakawa kadan amma a lokacin da nake a zahiri hankalina ya tafi gaba daya kuma na kama duk abincin da ya fi kusa da ni in tafi da sauri.
A gaskiya, ina ganin wannan ya fi muni fiye da yadda na yarda da kaina. Ban yi wata hira ta gaske da kowa ba sai mai dakina a cikin kamar sati uku.
Na ci gaba da tunanin in shiga wani abu amma sai na yi tunanin shiga cikin daki mai cike da baƙo kuma ba zan iya ba.
Wataƙila in fara da wani abu a kan layi amma ban ma san abin da nake sha'awar ba tun da na ke ware kaina sosai.
Na kasance ina matukar son daukar hoto kafin jami'a amma ban taba taba kamara ta tsawon watanni ba.
Ina jin tsoro cewa idan na buga hotuna na a kan layi mutane za su yi tunanin cewa suna da muni tun da ba ni da aiki.
Kun san abin da, watakila in fara da ɗaukar ƴan hotuna a kusa da harabar in ga yadda yake ji. Ba sai na nuna wa kowa ba tukuna.
Ina tsammanin zan gwada wannan yammacin lokacin da babu mutane da yawa a kusa. Na gode da taimaka min gano wannan.
Mo ti jẹ ounjẹ ọsan ninu ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ mi lojoojumọ dipo lilọ si gbongan ounjẹ. Mo sọ fun ara mi pe o dara ni ọna yii ṣugbọn Mo ro pe Mo kan n ṣe awọn awawi.
Bẹẹni, dajudaju o jẹ ohun aibalẹ awujọ. Gbọngan ile ijeun jẹ ariwo pupọ ati pe o kunju ati pe Emi ko mọ ibiti MO joko tabi tani lati joko pẹlu.
Mo gbiyanju lati lọ lakoko awọn wakati ti o ga julọ ṣugbọn paapaa nigba ti ko pọ si Mo tun lero bi gbogbo eniyan n tẹjumọ mi nigbati mo ba rin nikan.
Mo mọ pẹlu ọgbọn pe eniyan le ma wo mi ṣugbọn ko ṣe pataki - ọkan mi tun bẹrẹ ere-ije ni iṣẹju keji ti Mo rin nipasẹ awọn ilẹkun yẹn.
Nkan mimi ṣe iranlọwọ diẹ ṣugbọn ni akoko ti Mo wa nibe nibẹ ni ọkan mi lọ ṣofo patapata ati pe Mo kan mu ohunkohun ti ounjẹ ti o sunmọ julọ ki o lọ kuro ni yarayara bi o ti ṣee.
Lootọ, Mo ro pe eyi buru ju Mo ti jẹwọ fun ara mi. Emi ko tii ni ibaraẹnisọrọ gidi pẹlu ẹnikẹni ayafi ẹlẹgbẹ mi ni bii ọsẹ mẹta.
Mo n ronu pe MO yẹ ki o darapọ mọ nkan kan ṣugbọn lẹhinna Mo fojuinu lilọ sinu yara kan ti o kun fun awọn alejò ati pe Emi ko le ṣe.
Boya MO yẹ ki o bẹrẹ pẹlu nkan lori ayelujara ni akọkọ ṣugbọn Emi ko paapaa mọ ohun ti Mo nifẹ si mọ lati igba ti Mo ti ya ara mi sọtọ pupọ.
Mo fẹran fọtoyiya gaan ṣaaju kọlẹji ṣugbọn Emi ko fi ọwọ kan kamẹra mi ni awọn oṣu.
Mo bẹru pe ti MO ba fi awọn fọto mi ranṣẹ lori ayelujara awọn eniyan yoo ro pe wọn jẹ ẹru nitori Emi ko ni adaṣe.
O mọ kini, boya MO yẹ ki o kan bẹrẹ nipa gbigbe awọn fọto diẹ ni ayika ogba ati wo bi o ṣe rilara. Emi ko ni lati fihan ẹnikẹni sibẹsibẹ.
Mo ro pe Emi yoo gbiyanju ni ọsan yii nigbati ko si ọpọlọpọ eniyan ni ayika. O ṣeun fun ran mi ro ero yi jade.
I had someone tell me my presentation was really good today and I immediately started listing everything that went wrong with it. Why can't I just say thank you like a normal person?
I mean, it's not really imposter syndrome though - there actually were things wrong with my presentation. I stumbled over words and my slides had typos. So wasn't I just being honest?
But what if the person giving the compliment just didn't notice the mistakes or has low standards? Like, maybe they're just being nice and don't actually think it was good.
I guess it's just that... okay, this is going to sound pathetic, but I'm terrified that if I accept praise, people will expect more from me next time and I'll disappoint them.
What if I just keep my expectations really low so no one gets disappointed? That seems safer than risking letting people down.
Honestly, that all sounds exhausting. I just want to do okay without anyone paying too much attention to me.
But what if "just okay" isn't actually okay and I'm just being lazy or making excuses?
I think I'm scared that if I try harder, I'll find out I'm actually not that capable and then I won't even have the excuse that I wasn't really trying.
Maybe I should just accept that I'm average and stop overthinking this whole thing.
I don't know. Maybe I'm just making this too complicated and should focus on getting through college first.
You're probably right. I think I just get in my own head too much about this stuff.
Thanks. I guess I should probably work on just saying "thank you" when someone compliments me instead of immediately tearing apart my work.
Actually, wait - what if someone compliments me and I genuinely think they're wrong? Like if they say my essay was well-written but I know it was rushed and terrible?
Is it bad that I almost trust my judgment more than theirs when I know something was rushed or sloppy?
So maybe the issue isn't that I can't accept praise, but that I'm just more honest about quality than other people are?
Ina da wani ya gaya mani gabatarwata ta yi kyau sosai a yau kuma nan da nan na fara jera duk abin da ba daidai ba. Me yasa bazan iya cewa na gode ba kamar mutum na yau da kullun?

Ina nufin, ba da gaske ba ciwo ba ne ko da yake - a zahiri akwai abubuwan da ba daidai ba game da gabatarwa na. Na yi tuntuɓe kan kalmomi kuma nunin faifai na suna da rubutu. To ashe ba gaskiya nake yi ba?
Amma idan mutumin da yake yabon bai lura da kura-kurai ba fa ko kuma yana da ƙanƙanta? Kamar, watakila suna da kyau kawai kuma ba sa tunanin yana da kyau.
Ina tsammanin hakan ne kawai... okay, wannan zai zama abin tausayi, amma na firgita cewa idan na karɓi yabo, mutane za su sa ran fiye da ni a gaba kuma zan ba su kunya.
Idan kawai na ci gaba da sa raina da gaske don haka babu wanda ya ci nasara fa? Wannan da alama ya fi aminci fiye da haɗarin barin mutane.
Gaskiya, cewa duk sautin gajiya. Ina so in yi okay ba tare da kowa ya kula da ni ba.
Amma idan "lafiya kawai" ba a zahiri ba daidai ba ne kuma ina yin kasala ne ko yin uzuri?

Wataƙila ya kamata in yarda cewa ni matsakaici ne kuma in daina tunanin wannan duka.
Ban sani ba. Wataƙila ina yin wannan yana da rikitarwa kuma ya kamata in mai da hankali kan samun shiga kwalejin farko.
Wataƙila kun yi gaskiya. Ina tsammanin kawai na shiga cikin kaina da yawa game da wannan kayan.
Godiya. Ina tsammanin ya kamata in yi aiki kan kawai in ce "na gode" lokacin da wani ya yaba ni maimakon nan da nan yaga aikina.
A gaskiya, jira - menene idan wani ya yaba ni kuma ina jin da gaske suna kuskure? Kamar idan sun ce rubutuna ya yi kyau amma na san an yi gaggawa da muni?
Shin yana da kyau na kusan yarda da hukunci na fiye da nasu lokacin da na san wani abu ya yi gaggawa ko ya ɓace?
