Menene ma'anar ƙoƙarin gyara wannan yayin da akwai sauran ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya da yawa waɗanda har yanzu suna kulawa? Wataƙila tsarin zai yi aiki mafi kyau ba tare da ƙona mutane kamar ni a ciki ba.
Ba na so in zama wahayin wani. Ina so ne in sani ko a zahiri zai yiwu in dawo daga wannan ko kuma na yaudari kaina ina tunanin zan iya gyara duk abin da ya karye a cikina.
Ba zan iya samun lokacin hutu don magance wannan ba, kuma ba zan iya yin magani a lokutan aiki ba. Ta yaya zan warke yayin da nake cikin yanayin da ya kone ni tun farko?
Mo maa n padanu oorun ni aibalẹ nipa awọn alaisan mi, ati ni bayi Mo ṣe aago ni deede 5 PM laisi ero keji nipa eyikeyi ninu wọn. Nigba wo ni MO di eniyan yii ti o kan lọ nipasẹ awọn išipopada?
Mo n ronu pe akoko kan pato wa nigbati nkan kan kan tẹ ni pipa, ṣugbọn Emi ko le tọka si. Ṣe iyẹn jẹ oye tabi sisun sisun nigbagbogbo n ṣẹlẹ diẹ sii ni diėdiė?
Iṣoro naa ni Emi ko le sọ boya iyapa yii n daabobo mi gangan tabi ti MO ba kan di alabojuto buruju. Bawo ni o ṣe mọ iyatọ naa?
Mo tun ṣe iṣẹ mi ni pipe, ṣugbọn Mo lo lati * rilara * nkankan gangan nigbati alaisan kan ba dara tabi buru. Bayi o kan awọn aaye data lori chart kan. Ṣe iyẹn deede tabi o yẹ ki n ṣe aniyan?
Njẹ o le pada si rilara awọn nkan lẹẹkansi tabi ṣe eyi yẹ ni kete ti o ṣẹlẹ? Emi ko fẹ lati fi iṣẹ ilera silẹ ṣugbọn emi ko tun fẹ lati jẹ roboti fun iyoku iṣẹ mi.
Kini ti MO ba gbiyanju gbogbo nkan yẹn ati pe Emi ko tun lero nkankan? Mo n ṣe aniyan pe Mo ti fọ nkan kan ninu ara mi ti ko le ṣe atunṣe.
Emi ko paapaa mọ boya Mo fẹ lati lero awọn nkan lẹẹkansi. Boya jijẹ ni irọrun rọrun ati pe Mo yẹ ki o kan gba.
Mo ro pe Mo bẹru pe ti MO ba jẹ ki ara mi lero lẹẹkansi, Emi yoo pada si jije ẹni yẹn ti ko le sun nitori Mo ni aniyan nipa awọn alaisan. Emi ko fẹ lati jẹ ipalara yẹn lẹẹkansi.
Bawo ni MO ṣe bẹrẹ kekere pẹlu awọn ohun rilara? Emi ko le kan yi pada ki o si pinnu lati bikita nipa a alaisan loni.
Kini ti MO ba ṣe akiyesi nkan wọnyi ṣugbọn ṣi ko ni rilara ohunkohun? Bii Mo ṣe le ṣe akiyesi pe oṣuwọn ọkan mi yipada ṣugbọn ko tumọ si abojuto gangan.
Mo gbiyanju lati rẹrin musẹ si alaisan kan loni ati pe o ro pe iro ni Mo ro pe wọn le sọ. Eyi lero ainireti.
Boya Mo yẹ ki o yipada si aaye ti o yatọ patapata. O kere ju lẹhinna Emi kii yoo dibọn lati bikita nipa alafia eniyan nigbati Emi ko ṣe kedere mọ.
Kini aaye ti igbiyanju lati ṣatunṣe eyi nigbati ọpọlọpọ awọn oṣiṣẹ ilera miiran wa ti o tun ṣe abojuto gangan? Awọn eto yoo jasi ṣiṣe awọn dara lai iná jade eniyan bi mi ni o.
Emi ko fẹ lati jẹ imisinu ẹlomiran. Mo kan fẹ lati mọ boya o ṣee ṣe nitootọ lati pada wa lati eyi tabi ti MO ba n tan ara mi jẹ nironu pe MO le ṣatunṣe ohunkohun ti o fọ inu mi.

Emi ko le ni anfani lati gba akoko kuro ni iṣẹ lati koju eyi, ati pe Emi ko le ṣe itọju ailera lakoko awọn wakati iṣẹ. Bawo ni MO ṣe yẹ lati mu larada nigba ti Mo tun wa ni agbegbe ti o sun mi ni ibẹrẹ?

I need to talk through something that happened today. My colleague Sarah handed in her resignation and instead of feeling bad for the department or worried about her, I just felt jealous that she gets to leave.

That's the thing though - I'm supposed to be helping people with their mental health and here I am bitter that someone escaped. How can I tell patients to work through their problems when I can't even handle my own feelings about a coworker leaving?
But that's exactly what I mean - I'm not being an effective therapist. I've been going through the motions for months, giving people the same coping strategies I don't even use myself.
I can't take time off. We're already understaffed and if I leave too, that's just more burden on everyone else who's probably feeling the same way I am.
My supervisor is part of the problem - she just talks about "resilience" and "self-care" while piling on more cases. I'm starting to think this whole field is just broken.
How do I even know if I still want to be in this field? I used to care about helping people but now I just feel numb when patients tell me about their problems.
What if I've just been fooling myself this whole time and I was never actually good at helping people? Maybe Sarah was smart to get out before she wasted more years.

I can't even remember the last time I felt like I actually helped someone. When patients say they feel better, I just wonder if they're lying to make me feel good or if they would have gotten better anyway.
I keep telling myself all that but it doesn't change how empty I feel when I'm sitting across from someone in pain and I have nothing real to offer them.
Maybe I should just quit like Sarah did. At least then I wouldn't be taking up space that someone who actually cares could fill.
I've been trying to hold it together for months and I'm just tired of pretending everything is fine. What's the point of exploring options when the whole system is designed to burn people out?
I don't want to advocate or join groups or fight the system. I just want to not feel like garbage every day when I go to work.
How do I even start with self-care when I feel guilty taking any time for myself while my patients are struggling?

The idea of modeling healthy boundaries feels like a joke when I can't even set them for myself. I tell my patients to prioritize their needs while I'm staying late every night because I can't say no to more cases.
But how do I say no when I know there's nobody else to take those cases and people are on waiting lists for months?
Ina bukata in yi magana ta wani abu da ya faru a yau. Abokiyar aikina Sarah ta mika mata takardar murabus, maimakon in ji bacin rai ga sashen ko damuwa da ita, sai kawai na ji kishi na ta tafi.

Abin da ke faruwa ke nan - Ya kamata in taimaka wa mutane da lafiyar hankalinsu kuma a nan na ji haushi cewa wani ya tsere. Ta yaya zan iya gaya wa marasa lafiya su magance matsalolinsu yayin da ba zan iya magance yadda nake ji game da barin abokin aiki ba?
Amma wannan shi ne ainihin abin da nake nufi - Ba ni zama likita mai tasiri ba. Na yi wata-wata-wata na yi ta yin aiki, ina ba wa mutane dabaru iri ɗaya na jurewa da ni ma ba na amfani da kaina.
Ba zan iya ɗaukar lokaci ba. Mun riga mun rasa ma'aikata kuma idan na tafi ma, wannan shine kawai nauyi a kan kowa da kowa wanda ke iya ji kamar yadda nake ji.
Mai kula da ni wani bangare ne na matsalar - tana magana ne kawai game da "juriya" da "kula da kai" yayin da take tattara abubuwa da yawa. Na fara tunanin duk filin nan ya karye.
Ta yaya zan iya sanin ko har yanzu ina so in kasance a wannan filin? A da na damu da taimaka wa mutane amma yanzu ina jin damuwa lokacin da marasa lafiya suka gaya mini matsalolinsu.
Idan na kasance ina yaudarar kaina a wannan lokacin kuma ban taba iya taimaka wa mutane ba? Wataƙila Sarah tana da wayo don fita kafin ta ƙara ɓata shekaru.
Ba zan iya tunawa da ƙarshe lokacin da na ji kamar na taimaka wa wani. Lokacin da marasa lafiya suka ce sun ji daɗi, kawai ina mamakin ko karya suke yi don su ji daɗi ko kuma da sun sami sauƙi.
Na ci gaba da gaya wa kaina duk wannan amma bai canza yadda nake ji ba lokacin da nake zaune a gaban wani mai zafi kuma ba ni da wani abu na gaske da zan ba su.
Wataƙila ya kamata in daina kamar yadda Sarah ta yi. Aƙalla to ba zan ɗauki sararin samaniya ba wanda wanda a zahiri ya damu zai iya cikawa.
Na dade ina kokarin rike shi har tsawon watanni kuma na gaji da tunanin komai yana da kyau. Menene ma'anar bincika zaɓuɓɓuka lokacin da aka tsara tsarin duka don ƙone mutane?
Ba na so in yi shawara ko shiga kungiyoyi ko yaki da tsarin. Ina son kada in ji kamar sharar kowace rana idan na je aiki.
Ta yaya zan fara da kulawa da kai lokacin da na ji laifin ɗaukar kowane lokaci don kaina yayin da majiyyata ke fama?

Tunanin yin ƙirar iyakoki lafiya yana jin kamar wasa lokacin da ba zan iya saita su don kaina ba. Ina gaya wa majiyyata da su ba da fifiko ga bukatunsu yayin da nake kwana a kowane dare saboda ba zan iya cewa a'a ga ƙarin lokuta ba.
Amma ta yaya zan ce a'a alhali na san babu wani da zai ɗauki waɗannan shari'o'in kuma mutane suna cikin jerin jiran aiki na tsawon watanni?
Mo nilo lati sọrọ nipasẹ nkan ti o ṣẹlẹ loni. Arabinrin ẹlẹgbẹ mi Sarah fi ifisilẹ rẹ silẹ ati pe dipo rilara buburu fun ẹka tabi aibalẹ nipa rẹ, Mo kan ni ilawu pe o ni lati lọ kuro.

Iyẹn ni ohun botilẹjẹpe - Mo yẹ ki n ṣe iranlọwọ fun eniyan pẹlu ilera ọpọlọ wọn ati pe nibi ni inu mi dun pe ẹnikan salọ. Bawo ni MO ṣe le sọ fun awọn alaisan lati ṣiṣẹ nipasẹ awọn iṣoro wọn nigbati Emi ko le mu awọn ikunsinu ti ara mi nipa ti alabaṣiṣẹpọ kan ti nlọ?
Ṣugbọn iyẹn ni pato ohun ti Mo tumọ si - Emi kii ṣe oniwosan ti o munadoko. Mo ti lọ nipasẹ awọn iṣipopada fun awọn oṣu, ni fifun eniyan ni awọn ọgbọn didamu kanna Emi ko paapaa lo ara mi.
Emi ko le gba akoko isinmi. A ti ko ni oṣiṣẹ tẹlẹ ati pe ti MO ba lọ paapaa, iyẹn jẹ ẹru diẹ sii lori gbogbo eniyan miiran ti o ṣee ṣe rilara ni ọna kanna ti Emi.
Alabojuto mi jẹ apakan ti iṣoro naa - o kan sọrọ nipa “resilience” ati “itọju ara ẹni” lakoko ti o ṣajọpọ lori awọn ọran diẹ sii. Mo bẹrẹ lati ro pe gbogbo aaye yii ti ṣẹ.
Bawo ni MO ṣe le mọ boya MO tun fẹ lati wa ni aaye yii? Mo máa ń bìkítà nípa ríran àwọn èèyàn lọ́wọ́ tẹ́lẹ̀ àmọ́ ní báyìí, ara mi máa ń dùn nígbà tí àwọn aláìsàn bá sọ fún mi nípa ìṣòro wọn.
Kini ti MO ba kan tan ara mi jẹ ni gbogbo akoko yii ati pe Emi ko dara rara ni iranlọwọ awọn eniyan? Boya Sarah jẹ ọlọgbọn lati jade ṣaaju ki o to padanu ọdun diẹ sii.

Emi ko le ranti awọn ti o kẹhin akoko ti mo ro bi mo ti kosi ran ẹnikan. Nigbati awọn alaisan ba sọ pe ara wọn dara, Mo kan iyalẹnu boya wọn n purọ lati jẹ ki inu mi dun tabi boya wọn yoo ti dara si lọnakọna.
Mo n sọ gbogbo eyi fun ara mi ṣugbọn ko yipada bi o ṣe ṣofo ti Mo lero nigbati Mo joko kọja ẹnikan ti o ni irora ati pe Emi ko ni nkankan gidi lati fun wọn.
Boya o yẹ ki n kan fi silẹ bi Sarah ti ṣe. O kere ju lẹhinna Emi kii yoo gba aaye ti ẹnikan ti o bikita le kun.
Mo ti n gbiyanju lati mu u papọ fun awọn oṣu ati pe o kan rẹ mi lati dibọn ohun gbogbo dara. Kini aaye ti ṣawari awọn aṣayan nigbati gbogbo eto ti ṣe apẹrẹ lati sun eniyan jade?
Emi ko fẹ lati dijo tabi darapọ mọ awọn ẹgbẹ tabi ja eto naa. Mo kan fẹ lati ma lero bi idoti ni gbogbo ọjọ nigbati mo ba lọ si iṣẹ.
Bawo ni MO ṣe bẹrẹ paapaa pẹlu itọju ara ẹni nigbati Mo lero pe o jẹbi gbigba eyikeyi akoko fun ara mi lakoko ti awọn alaisan mi n tiraka?

Awọn agutan ti modeli ni ilera aala kan lara bi a awada nigbati Emi ko le ani ṣeto wọn fun ara mi. Mo sọ fun awọn alaisan mi lati ṣe pataki awọn iwulo wọn lakoko ti Mo n duro pẹ ni gbogbo alẹ nitori Emi ko le sọ rara si awọn ọran diẹ sii.
Ṣugbọn bawo ni MO ṣe sọ rara nigbati Mo mọ pe ko si ẹnikan miiran lati mu awọn ọran wọnyẹn ati pe eniyan wa lori awọn atokọ idaduro fun awọn oṣu?

I keep replaying this stupid medication dosage calculation I messed up yesterday. Nobody got hurt because the pharmacist caught it, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm failing at the one thing I'm supposed to be good at.

I know logically that everyone makes mistakes, but I hold myself to this impossible standard where I'm not allowed to be human. How do I actually stop beating myself up when my brain keeps telling me I should never mess up?
But how do I actually catch those thoughts in the moment? By the time I realize I'm spiraling, I've already been beating myself up for hours and I'm exhausted from it.
I tried the rubber band thing once but I felt ridiculous doing it. What if I'm just too cynical for these techniques to work on me?

What about when the cynicism feels justified though? Like, I see coworkers making the same mistakes over and over, management that doesn't care, and I'm supposed to just positive-think my way through that reality?
So I'm just supposed to accept that this is how healthcare is and find ways to cope with a broken system instead of being angry about it?
I don't have the energy for advocacy right now. I can barely get through my shifts without feeling like I'm drowning.
How do I even start with self-care when everything feels pointless and I'm already judging myself for needing help in the first place?
I feel like a fraud though - how can I take care of myself when I'm supposed to be taking care of others?
But what if I don't even know what would make me feel better anymore? I've been running on empty for so long I can't remember what actually helps.
I keep thinking I should just quit nursing and do something else, but then I remember all the training and debt and I feel trapped.
What if I'm just not cut out for this and all those years of education were a mistake?
I'm tired of talking about this. Nothing's going to change anyway.
Why do people even bother trying to help when everything just goes back to the way it was anyway?
I guess I just don't see the point in pretending things will get better when they obviously won't.

Na ci gaba da sake kunna wannan wauta lissafin adadin magunguna da na lalata jiya. Babu wanda ya ji rauni saboda mai harhada magunguna ya kama shi, amma ba zan iya girgiza jin cewa na gaza a abu daya da ya kamata in yi kyau a kai ba.

Na san a hankali cewa kowa yana yin kuskure, amma na riƙe kaina ga wannan mizanin da ba zai yiwu ba inda ba a yarda ni zama ɗan adam ba. Ta yaya zan daina dukan kaina lokacin da kwakwalwata ta ci gaba da gaya mani cewa kada in yi rikici?
Amma ta yaya zan iya kama waɗannan tunanin a lokacin? A lokacin da na gane cewa ina zage-zage, na riga na yi wa kaina duka na tsawon sa'o'i kuma na gaji da shi.
Na gwada abin robar sau ɗaya amma na ji ba'a yin sa. Me zai faru idan na kasance mai banƙyama don waɗannan fasahohin suyi aiki a kaina?

Me game da lokacin da cynicism ya ji barata ko? Kamar, Ina ganin abokan aiki suna yin kuskure iri ɗaya akai-akai, gudanarwar da ba ta damu ba, kuma ya kamata in yi tunani mai kyau kawai ta hanyar wannan gaskiyar?
Don haka kawai ya kamata in yarda cewa wannan shine yadda kiwon lafiya yake da kuma nemo hanyoyin da za a bi da tsarin da ya karye maimakon yin fushi game da shi?
Ba ni da kuzarin bayar da shawarwari a yanzu. Da kyar nake iya jurewa ayyukana ba tare da jin kamar na nutse ba.
Ta yaya zan fara da kulawa da kai lokacin da komai ya ji ba shi da ma'ana kuma na riga na yanke wa kaina hukunci don buƙatar taimako tun farko?
Ina jin kamar zamba ko da yake - ta yaya zan iya kula da kaina lokacin da ya kamata in kula da wasu?
Amma idan ban ma san me zai sa na ji daɗi fa? Na dade ina gudu a fanko ba zan iya tuna abin da a zahiri ke taimakawa ba.
Ina ci gaba da tunanin cewa ya kamata in bar aikin jinya kawai in yi wani abu dabam, amma sai na tuna duk horo da bashi kuma na ji tarko.
Idan ba a yanke ni ba don wannan kuma duk waɗannan shekarun ilimi sun kasance kuskure?
Na gaji da maganar wannan. Babu wani abu da zai canza ta wata hanya.
Me ya sa mutane ma suke damuwa da ƙoƙarin taimakawa yayin da komai ya koma yadda yake?
Ina tsammanin ban ga ma'anar yin kamar abubuwa za su yi kyau ba lokacin da ba za su yi ba.
Mo tẹsiwaju lati tun ṣe iṣiro iwọn oogun aṣiwere yii Mo bajẹ lana. Ko si ẹnikan ti o farapa nitori pe oloogun naa mu, ṣugbọn Emi ko le gbọn rilara pe MO kuna ni ohun kan ti Mo yẹ ki o dara ni.

Mo mọ pẹlu ọgbọn pe gbogbo eniyan n ṣe awọn aṣiṣe, ṣugbọn Mo di ara mi mu si boṣewa ti ko ṣee ṣe nibiti a ko gba mi laaye lati jẹ eniyan. Bawo ni MO ṣe dawọ lilu ara mi gaan nigba ti ọpọlọ mi n sọ fun mi pe Emi ko yẹ ki o daru rara?
Ṣugbọn bawo ni MO ṣe mu awọn ero yẹn gangan ni akoko yii? Ni akoko ti Mo rii pe Mo n yiyi, Mo ti n lu ara mi tẹlẹ fun awọn wakati pupọ ati pe o rẹ mi lati ọdọ rẹ.
Mo gbiyanju awọn roba band ohun ni kete ti sugbon mo ro yeye ṣe o. Ohun ti o ba ti Mo wa o kan ju cynical fun awọn wọnyi ni imuposi lati sise lori mi?
Kini nipa nigbati cynicism kan lara lare botilẹjẹpe? Bii, Mo rii awọn alabaṣiṣẹpọ ti n ṣe awọn aṣiṣe kanna leralera, iṣakoso ti ko bikita, ati pe MO yẹ ki o kan ni rere-ronu ọna mi nipasẹ otitọ yẹn?
Nitorinaa MO yẹ ki n gba pe eyi ni bii ilera ṣe jẹ ati wa awọn ọna lati koju eto ti o bajẹ dipo ti ibinu nipa rẹ?
Emi ko ni agbara fun agbawi ni bayi. Mo ti le ti awọ gba nipasẹ mi lásìkò lai rilara bi mo ti n rì.
Bawo ni MO ṣe bẹrẹ paapaa pẹlu itọju ara ẹni nigbati ohun gbogbo ba ni asan ati pe Mo n ṣe idajọ ara mi tẹlẹ fun nilo iranlọwọ ni ibẹrẹ?
Mo lero bi a jegudujera tilẹ - bawo ni mo ti le toju ara mi nigba ti mo ti n ikure lati wa ni toju ti elomiran?
Àmọ́ tí mi ò bá tiẹ̀ mọ ohun tó máa jẹ́ kí ara mi túbọ̀ dára sí i ńkọ́? Mo ti nṣiṣẹ lori ofo fun igba pipẹ Emi ko le ranti kini iranlọwọ gangan.
Mo máa ń rò ó pé kí n jáwọ́ nínú iṣẹ́ ìtọ́jú kí n sì ṣe ohun mìíràn, ṣùgbọ́n nígbà náà, mo rántí gbogbo ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àti gbèsè tí mo sì nímọ̀lára ìdẹkùn.
Kini ti Emi ko ba ge fun eyi ati pe gbogbo awọn ọdun ẹkọ wọnyẹn jẹ aṣiṣe?
Ọrọ yii ti rẹ mi. Ko si ohun ti yoo yi lonakona.
Kilode ti awọn eniyan paapaa ṣe wahala lati gbiyanju lati ṣe iranlọwọ nigbati ohun gbogbo ba pada si ọna ti o jẹ lonakona?
Mo gboju pe Emi ko rii aaye ni dibọn awọn nkan yoo dara nigbati wọn han gbangba kii yoo.
I went home last night and just sat there staring at my phone while my kids tried to show me their drawings. I had nothing left to give them after dealing with patients all day.
That's the problem though - I know all this stuff already. I tell my patients the same things about self-care and asking for help, but when I try to apply it to myself it feels like bullshit.
Why is it that I can sit with a suicidal patient and feel genuine empathy, but when my own kid wants to show me a picture they drew I just feel... empty? Like there's literally nothing there to give.
I keep thinking maybe I should just quit, but then what? I've spent years building this career and I'm good at what I do when I'm not completely burned out.
I can't take time off - we're already understaffed and people are depending on me. The guilt of leaving my patients would probably be worse than how I feel now.
How do I even begin to explain to my partner that I'm struggling when they're already picking up all the slack at home because of my work schedule?
I'm worried if I tell them how bad it really is, they'll think I can't handle my job and should quit. But we need my income and insurance.
What if I'm just not cut out for this? Maybe some people are just too sensitive to handle healthcare.
I used to love this work. I remember feeling like I was making a real difference, but now I just feel like I'm going through the motions.
Every patient feels like they're taking something from me now instead of it feeling like an exchange. I don't know how to get that feeling back.
Sometimes I catch myself being short with patients and I hate myself for it. These people are already vulnerable and hurting, and here I am adding to it because I can't get my own shit together.
I don't even know who I am outside of work anymore. When someone asks me what I like to do for fun, I literally can't think of anything.
I keep thinking about this patient I lost last month and wondering if I did everything I could. It's eating at me.
I wonder if they would have made it if I had called the attending sooner. I keep replaying that night in my head.
How do you stop seeing their face every time you close your eyes?
Na tafi gida jiya da daddare na zauna kawai ina kallon wayata yayin da yarana ke kokarin nuna min zanen su. Ba ni da wani abin da zan ba su bayan mu'amala da marasa lafiya duk rana.

Wannan ita ce matsalar ko da yake - Na san duk waɗannan abubuwan tuni. Ina gaya wa majiyyata abubuwa iri ɗaya game da kulawa da kai da neman taimako, amma lokacin da na yi ƙoƙarin amfani da shi ga kaina sai in ji kamar bacin rai.

Me yasa zan iya zama tare da mai kashe kansa kuma in ji tausayi na gaske, amma lokacin da yarona yana so ya nuna mini hoto sun zana sai kawai na ji ... komai? Kamar babu wani abu a zahiri don bayarwa.
Na ci gaba da tunanin watakila in daina, amma sai me? Na shafe shekaru ina gina wannan sana’a kuma na kware a abin da nake yi lokacin da ban gama konewa ba.
Ba zan iya samun hutu ba - mun riga mun gaza kuma mutane sun dogara da ni. Laifin barin majiyyata zai yiwu ya fi yadda nake ji a yanzu.
Ta yaya zan fara bayyana wa abokin aikina cewa ina kokawa a lokacin da suka riga sun tsinci duk wata kasala a gida saboda jadawalin aikina?
Ina cikin damuwa idan na gaya musu yadda abin yake da gaske, za su yi tunanin ba zan iya ɗaukar aikina ba kuma ya kamata in daina. Amma muna buƙatar kudin shiga na da inshora.
Idan ba a yanke ni don wannan fa? Wataƙila wasu mutane sun fi damuwa da kula da lafiya.
Na kasance ina son wannan aikin. Na tuna kamar ina yin canji na gaske, amma yanzu ina jin kamar ina cikin motsi.
Kowane majiyyaci yana jin kamar suna karɓar wani abu daga gare ni a yanzu maimakon ya ji kamar musanyawa. Ban san yadda zan dawo da wannan jin ba.

Wani lokaci nakan kama kaina a takaice tare da marasa lafiya kuma na ƙi kaina saboda shi. Wadannan mutanen sun riga sun zama masu rauni kuma suna cutar da su, kuma a nan na kara da shi saboda ba zan iya hadawa da kaina ba.
Ban ma san ko ni waye a wajen aiki ba. Lokacin da wani ya tambaye ni abin da nake so in yi don nishaɗi, a zahiri ba zan iya tunanin komai ba.
Ina ci gaba da tunanin wannan majinyacin da na rasa a watan da ya gabata kuma ina tunanin ko na yi duk abin da zan iya. Yana ci a kaina.
Ina mamakin ko da sun yi hakan da na kira masu halarta da wuri. Na ci gaba da maimaita wannan dare a cikin kaina.
Yaya za ku daina ganin fuskar su a duk lokacin da kuka rufe idanunku?

Mo lọ si ile ni alẹ ana ati pe Mo kan joko nibẹ ti n wo foonu mi lakoko ti awọn ọmọ mi gbiyanju lati fi awọn iyaworan wọn han mi. Emi ko ni nkankan ti o kù lati fun wọn lẹhin ṣiṣe pẹlu awọn alaisan ni gbogbo ọjọ.

Iyẹn ni iṣoro botilẹjẹpe - Mo mọ gbogbo nkan yii tẹlẹ. Mo sọ fun awọn alaisan mi awọn nkan kanna nipa itọju ara ẹni ati beere fun iranlọwọ, ṣugbọn nigbati Mo gbiyanju lati lo si ara mi o kan lara bi bullshit.
Kini idi ti MO le joko pẹlu alaisan suicidal ati ki o ni itara tootọ, ṣugbọn nigbati ọmọ ti ara mi fẹ lati fi aworan han mi ti wọn ya Mo kan lero ... ofo? Bi nibẹ ni gangan ohunkohun nibẹ lati fun.
Mo n ronu boya MO yẹ ki o kan dawọ silẹ, ṣugbọn lẹhinna kini? Mo ti lo ọpọlọpọ ọdun ni kikọ iṣẹ yii ati pe Mo dara ni ohun ti Mo ṣe nigbati Emi ko jona patapata.
Emi ko le gba akoko kuro - a ti ni alainiṣẹ tẹlẹ ati pe eniyan da lori mi. Ẹbi ti fifi awọn alaisan mi silẹ yoo jasi buru ju bi o ṣe lero mi ni bayi.
Bawo ni MO ṣe paapaa bẹrẹ lati ṣalaye fun alabaṣepọ mi pe Mo n tiraka nigba ti wọn ti n gba gbogbo awọn asan ni ile nitori iṣeto iṣẹ mi?
Mo n ṣe aniyan ti MO ba sọ fun wọn bi o ti buru to gaan, wọn yoo ro pe Emi ko le ṣakoso iṣẹ mi ati pe o yẹ ki o fi iṣẹ silẹ. Ṣugbọn a nilo owo oya mi ati iṣeduro.
Ohun ti o ba ti mo ti n kan ko ge jade fun yi? Boya diẹ ninu awọn eniyan kan ni itara pupọ lati mu itọju ilera.
Mo nifẹ iṣẹ yii tẹlẹ. Mo ranti rilara bi mo ṣe n ṣe iyatọ gidi, ṣugbọn nisisiyi Mo kan lero bi Mo n lọ nipasẹ awọn išipopada.
Gbogbo alaisan kan lara bi wọn ṣe n gba nkan lọwọ mi ni bayi dipo ki o rilara bi paṣipaarọ. Emi ko mọ bi o ṣe le gba rilara yẹn pada.

Nigba miiran Mo gba ara mi ni kukuru pẹlu awọn alaisan ati pe Mo korira ara mi fun rẹ. Awọn eniyan wọnyi ti ni ipalara tẹlẹ ati ipalara, ati pe nibi Mo n ṣafikun si nitori Emi ko le gba eeyan ti ara mi papọ.
Mi o tile mo eni ti mo je lode ise mo. Nigbati ẹnikan ba beere lọwọ mi kini MO fẹ lati ṣe fun igbadun, Emi gangan ko le ronu ohunkohun.
Mo n ronu nipa alaisan yii ti Mo padanu ni oṣu to kọja ati iyalẹnu boya MO ṣe ohun gbogbo ti Mo le. O jẹun ni mi.
Mo ṣe kàyéfì bóyá wọ́n ì bá ti ṣe tí mo bá ti pe àwọn tó wá síbẹ̀ láìpẹ́. Mo tun ṣe ni alẹ yẹn ni ori mi.
Bawo ni o ṣe dẹkun ri oju wọn ni gbogbo igba ti o ba pa oju rẹ mọ?

Someone at work told me I need to practice more "self-care" and I wanted to roll my eyes so hard they'd fall out of my head. How is taking a bubble bath supposed to fix being understaffed and overworked?
Right, exactly - it's like putting a band-aid on a broken bone. The real issue is that we're asking three people to do the work of ten and then telling them to meditate about it.

The problem is management already knows we're drowning - they just don't care because hiring more people costs money. So when they suggest "wellness workshops" instead of actual staffing solutions, it feels like they're mocking us.
I've been in healthcare for eight years and it's gotten so much worse. The irony is that I'm supposed to be helping other people with their mental health while mine is completely shot.

The worst part is feeling like a fraud when I tell patients to prioritize their mental health and seek support when I can't even follow my own advice. How am I supposed to be credible when I'm running on empty?

I keep thinking about quitting but then I feel guilty because we're already so short-staffed and my patients need me. It's like being trapped in this cycle where caring too much is what's destroying me.
That's the thing though - I can't reduce my workload when we're already running with skeleton crews. And every time someone does quit, it just makes it worse for everyone else who stays.

Sometimes I wonder if the whole system is just designed to break people down until they accept that this is just how it is. Like maybe the burnout is intentional because burned out workers don't have the energy to demand better.
You're right that it feels intentional sometimes. The thing is, I'm not even sure I want to fight anymore - I'm just tired of being tired, you know?
I guess what gets me is that everyone acts like this is normal - like being completely drained and miserable at work is just part of being an adult. When did we all just accept that?
What really pisses me off is when people who've never worked in healthcare tell me I should just find another job, like it's that simple when you've spent years training for something specific.

The people saying "just find another job" are usually the same ones who clapped for healthcare workers during the pandemic and called us heroes. Now that the cameras are off, suddenly we're supposed to shut up and be grateful.
Exactly - we went from heroes to whiners in about six months. Makes you realize how shallow all that praise really was.

Sometimes I think the only way anything will actually change is if we all just walked out at once. But that's impossible because we actually care about our patients, which is exactly what they're counting on.
I just wonder if it's worth it anymore. Maybe I should have become an accountant or something - at least then I wouldn't feel guilty about leaving work at work.

Wani a wurin aiki ya ce mini ina bukatar in kara yin “kula da kai” kuma ina so in murza idanuwana sosai za su fado daga kaina. Ta yaya ya kamata yin wankan kumfa ya gyara rashin ma'aikata kuma ba a cika aiki ba?
Dama, daidai - yana kama da sanya bandeji a kan karyewar kashi. Maganar gaskiya ita ce, muna neman mutane uku su yi aikin goma sannan mu ce su yi tunani a kai.

Matsalar ita ce gudanarwa ta riga ta san cewa muna nutsewa - ba su damu ba saboda ɗaukar ƙarin mutane yana kashe kuɗi. Don haka lokacin da suka ba da shawarar "bitar lafiya" maimakon ainihin hanyoyin samar da ma'aikata, yana jin kamar suna yi mana ba'a.
Na yi shekara takwas a kiwon lafiya kuma abin ya yi muni sosai. Abin ban mamaki shi ne ya kamata in taimaka wa wasu mutane da lafiyar hankalinsu yayin da nawa aka harbe gaba daya.

Mafi munin sashi shine jin kamar zamba lokacin da na gaya wa marasa lafiya su fifita lafiyar tunaninsu da neman tallafi lokacin da ba zan iya bin shawarar kaina ba. Ta yaya zan zama mai gaskiya lokacin da nake gudu akan komai?

Na ci gaba da tunanin dainawa amma sai na ji laifi domin mun riga mun zama gajeriyar ma'aikata kuma marasa lafiya na suna bukatara. Kamar an kama ni a cikin wannan zagayowar inda kulawa da yawa shine abin da ke lalata ni.

Wannan shine abin ko da yake - Ba zan iya rage yawan aiki na ba lokacin da muka riga muka yi aiki tare da ma'aikatan kwarangwal. Kuma duk lokacin da wani ya daina aiki, yana ƙara tsananta ga duk wanda ya zauna.

Wani lokaci ina mamakin ko duk tsarin an tsara shi ne don lalata mutane har sai sun yarda cewa haka yake. Kamar watakila ƙonawar da gangan ne saboda ma'aikatan da suka kone ba su da kuzarin buƙata mafi kyau.
Kuna da gaskiya cewa yana jin niyya wani lokaci. Maganar ita ce, ban ma tabbatar da cewa ina son yin fada ba - Na gaji da gajiya, kun sani?

Ina tsammanin abin da ya same ni shi ne cewa kowa yana yin irin wannan abu ne na al'ada - kamar kasancewa gaba ɗaya kuma rashin tausayi a wurin aiki wani bangare ne na zama babba. Yaushe duk muka yarda da haka?

Abin da ke damun ni sosai shi ne lokacin da mutanen da ba su taɓa yin aiki a cikin kiwon lafiya ba su gaya mani cewa ya kamata in sami wani aiki, kamar yana da sauƙi lokacin da kuka shafe shekaru horarwa don wani abu na musamman.

Mutanen da ke cewa "kawai nemo wani aiki" yawanci iri ɗaya ne waɗanda suka yi tafawa ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya yayin bala'in kuma suka kira mu jarumai. Yanzu da kyamarori ke kashe, ba zato ba tsammani ya kamata mu rufe mu yi godiya.
Daidai - mun tashi daga jarumawa zuwa masu kururuwa a cikin kimanin watanni shida. Yana ba ku fahimtar yadda duk wannan yabo ya kasance marar zurfi.

Wani lokaci ina tsammanin hanya ɗaya kawai wani abu zai canza shine idan duk mun fita waje ɗaya kawai. Amma hakan ba zai yiwu ba saboda a zahiri muna kula da majinyatan mu, wanda shine ainihin abin da suke kirga.
Ina mamakin ko yana da daraja kuma. Wataƙila ya kamata in zama akawu ko wani abu - aƙalla sannan ba zan ji laifin barin aiki a wurin aiki ba.

Ẹnikan ti o wa ni iṣẹ sọ fun mi pe Mo nilo lati ṣe adaṣe diẹ sii “itọju ara ẹni” ati pe Mo fẹ lati yi oju mi ​​​​lọ lile ti wọn yoo ṣubu kuro ni ori mi. Bawo ni mimu iwẹ nkuta ṣe yẹ lati ṣatunṣe pe ko ni oṣiṣẹ ati iṣẹ lọpọlọpọ?
Ọtun, ni pato - o dabi fifi iranlọwọ-ẹgbẹ sori egungun ti o fọ. Ọrọ to daju ni pe a n beere lọwọ awọn eniyan mẹta lati ṣe iṣẹ mẹwa ati lẹhinna sọ fun wọn pe ki wọn ṣe àṣàrò nipa rẹ.

Iṣoro naa ni iṣakoso ti mọ pe a n rì - wọn kan ko bikita nitori igbanisise eniyan diẹ sii n san owo. Nitorinaa nigba ti wọn daba “awọn idanileko alafia” dipo awọn ojutu oṣiṣẹ gangan, o kan lara bi wọn ṣe n ṣe ẹlẹyà.
Mo ti wa ni ilera fun ọdun mẹjọ ati pe o buru pupọ. Awọn irony ni wipe Mo n ikure lati wa ni ran miiran eniyan pẹlu wọn opolo ilera nigba ti mi ti wa ni patapata shot.

Apakan ti o buru julọ ni rilara bi jegudujera nigbati Mo sọ fun awọn alaisan lati ṣe pataki ilera ọpọlọ wọn ki o wa atilẹyin nigbati Emi ko le tẹle imọran ti ara mi. Bawo ni MO ṣe yẹ lati jẹ igbẹkẹle nigbati Mo nṣiṣẹ lori ofo?

Mo n ronu nipa didasilẹ ṣugbọn lẹhinna Mo lero jẹbi nitori a ti ni oṣiṣẹ kukuru pupọ ati pe awọn alaisan mi nilo mi. O dabi pe o wa ni idẹkùn ni yiyiyi nibiti abojuto pupọ julọ jẹ ohun ti n pa mi run.
Iyẹn ni ohun botilẹjẹpe - Emi ko le dinku iwuwo iṣẹ mi nigbati a ti nṣiṣẹ tẹlẹ pẹlu awọn atukọ egungun. Ati ni gbogbo igba ti ẹnikan ba dawọ, o kan mu ki o buru si fun gbogbo eniyan miiran ti o duro.

Nigba miiran Mo ṣe iyalẹnu boya gbogbo eto naa jẹ apẹrẹ lati fọ awọn eniyan lulẹ titi wọn o fi gba pe eyi ni bii o ṣe jẹ. Bii boya sisun naa jẹ ipinnu nitori awọn oṣiṣẹ ti o jona ko ni agbara lati beere dara julọ.
O tọ pe o kan lara imomose nigba miiran. Nkan naa ni, Emi ko tile da mi loju pe mo fe jagun mo – O kan su mi lati re mi, se o mo?
Mo gboju pe ohun ti n gba mi ni pe gbogbo eniyan ṣe bii eyi jẹ deede - bii jijẹ patapata ati aibalẹ ni iṣẹ jẹ apakan ti jijẹ agbalagba. Nigbawo ni gbogbo wa kan gba iyẹn?
Ohun ti o binu mi gaan ni nigbati awọn eniyan ti ko ṣiṣẹ ni ilera tẹlẹ sọ fun mi pe MO yẹ ki o kan wa iṣẹ miiran, bii o rọrun yẹn nigbati o ti lo awọn ọdun ikẹkọ fun nkan kan pato.

Awọn eniyan ti n sọ pe “kan wa iṣẹ miiran” nigbagbogbo jẹ awọn kanna ti o ṣagbe fun awọn oṣiṣẹ ilera lakoko ajakaye-arun ti o pe wa ni akọni. Ni bayi ti awọn kamẹra ti wa ni pipa, lojiji o yẹ ki a tii ki a dupẹ.
Gangan – a si lọ lati Akikanju to whiiners ni nipa osu mefa. O jẹ ki o mọ bi gbogbo iyin ti jẹ aijinile.

Nigba miiran Mo ro pe ọna kan ṣoṣo ti ohunkohun yoo yipada ni gangan ti gbogbo wa ba kan jade ni ẹẹkan. Ṣugbọn iyẹn ko ṣee ṣe nitori a nifẹ si awọn alaisan wa gaan, eyiti o jẹ deede ohun ti wọn n ka lori.
Mo kan Iyanu boya o tọ si mọ. Boya MO yẹ ki n ti di oniṣiro tabi nkankan - o kere ju lẹhinna Emi kii yoo ni rilara nipa fifi iṣẹ silẹ ni iṣẹ.
I know this is ridiculous, but I've started getting this sick feeling in my stomach every Sunday afternoon and I can't figure out why the anticipation of Monday is worse than actually being at work.
I'm already in healthcare - I help other people with their mental health issues all day. The irony isn't lost on me that I'm asking for help when I'm supposed to be the one giving it.

Look, I get all that textbook stuff about self-care - I literally tell my patients the same things every day. What I want to understand is why my brain decides Sunday at 3pm is when it needs to start catastrophizing about Monday morning.
The thing that gets me is that I actually handle the difficult cases at work fine - it's not like Monday is objectively worse than any other day. But my body doesn't seem to care about logic.
What bothers me most is that I can see myself doing this - I know it's happening, I know it's not rational, and I still can't seem to stop it.
I've tried meditation apps and breathing exercises - they work in the moment but the pattern just comes back the next week.
Do you think this is just straight-up burnout and I'm overthinking the whole Sunday thing?
I just realized I haven't looked forward to anything work-related in months - not a single meeting, project, or even seeing certain colleagues I used to enjoy working with.
That's the thing though - I still believe in the work itself, helping people with their mental health. I just feel like I'm running on empty trying to do it.
I need to figure out how to recharge without feeling guilty about taking time away from patients who need help.
How do I even begin to rest when my brain keeps going through patient cases and wondering if I missed something important?
The worst part is that I tell my patients about the importance of self-care and work-life balance, and here I am completely unable to follow my own advice.
Sometimes I wonder if I should just leave healthcare altogether, but then I think about my patients and feel like I'd be abandoning them.
I keep going back and forth - one day I think I need a complete career change, the next day I remember why I got into this field in the first place.
I don't want to take the time to explore other options because I feel like every minute I spend not helping people is wasted.

Na san wannan abin ba'a ne, amma na fara samun wannan rashin lafiya a cikina kowace ranar Lahadi da yamma kuma ba zan iya gano dalilin da yasa tsammanin ranar Litinin ya fi muni da kasancewa a wurin aiki ba.

Na riga na kasance cikin kiwon lafiya - Ina taimaka wa wasu mutane game da matsalolin lafiyar kwakwalwarsu duk rana. Abin ban mamaki bai rasa ba a gare ni cewa ina neman taimako lokacin da ya kamata ni ne mai bayarwa.

Duba, Ina samun duk waɗannan abubuwan littafin koyarwa game da kulawa da kai - Ina gaya wa majiyyata abubuwa iri ɗaya kowace rana. Abin da nake so in fahimta shine dalilin da yasa kwakwalwata ke yanke shawarar ranar Lahadi da karfe 3 na yamma lokacin da yake buƙatar fara bala'i game da safiyar Litinin.
Abin da ya same ni shi ne cewa a zahiri na magance matsaloli masu wahala a wurin aiki lafiya - ba kamar Litinin ta fi kowace rana muni ba. Amma jikina bai damu da tunani ba.
Abin da ya fi daure mani rai shi ne, na ga kaina ina yin haka – na san abin yana faruwa, na san ba shi da ma’ana, kuma har yanzu ba zan iya dakatar da hakan ba.
Na gwada aikace-aikacen zuzzurfan tunani da motsa jiki na numfashi - suna aiki a lokacin amma tsarin yana dawowa mako mai zuwa.
Shin kuna ganin wannan ƙonawa ce kawai kuma na wuce tunanin duk ranar Lahadi?
Na gane kawai ban sa ido ga wani abu da ya shafi aiki a cikin watanni - ba taro ko aiki, ko ma ganin wasu abokan aiki da na saba jin daɗin yin aiki da su ba.
Wannan shi ne abin ko da yake - Har yanzu na yi imani da aikin da kansa, yana taimaka wa mutane da lafiyar kwakwalwarsu. Ina jin kamar ina gudu a kan komai ina ƙoƙarin yin shi.
Ina buƙatar gano yadda zan yi caji ba tare da jin laifi ba game da ɗaukar lokaci daga marasa lafiya waɗanda ke buƙatar taimako.
Ta yaya zan fara hutawa lokacin da kwakwalwata ta ci gaba da yin la'akari da rashin lafiya kuma ina tunanin ko na rasa wani abu mai mahimmanci?
Mafi muni shine na gaya wa majiyyata game da mahimmancin kulawa da kai da daidaiton rayuwa, kuma a nan ba zan iya bin shawarar kaina ba.
Wani lokaci ina tunanin ko zan bar kiwon lafiya gaba ɗaya, amma sai in yi tunani game da marasa lafiya na kuma in ji kamar zan yi watsi da su.
Ina ci gaba da komowa - wata rana ina tsammanin ina bukatar cikakkiyar canjin sana'a, washegari na tuna dalilin da ya sa na shigo wannan fagen tun farko.
Ba na so in dauki lokaci don bincika wasu zaɓuɓɓuka saboda ina jin kamar duk lokacin da na kashe ba ta taimaka wa mutane ba a banza.
Mo mọ pe eyi jẹ ẹgan, ṣugbọn Mo ti bẹrẹ si ni rilara aisan yii ni inu mi ni gbogbo ọsan ọjọ Sundee ati pe Emi ko le rii idi ti ifojusọna ti Ọjọ Aarọ buru ju kikopa gangan ni iṣẹ.

Mo ti wa ni ilera tẹlẹ - Mo ṣe iranlọwọ fun awọn eniyan miiran pẹlu awọn ọran ilera ọpọlọ wọn ni gbogbo ọjọ. Irony naa ko padanu lori mi pe Mo n beere fun iranlọwọ nigbati o yẹ ki o jẹ ẹni ti o fun mi.

Wo, Mo gba gbogbo nkan iwe-ẹkọ yẹn nipa itọju ara ẹni - Mo sọ fun awọn alaisan mi ni ohun kanna ni gbogbo ọjọ. Ohun ti Mo fẹ lati ni oye ni idi ti ọpọlọ mi ṣe pinnu Sunday ni 3pm ni igba ti o nilo lati bẹrẹ ajalu ni owurọ ọjọ Aarọ.
Ohun ti o gba mi ni pe Mo mu awọn ọran ti o nira gangan ṣiṣẹ ni itanran - kii ṣe bii Ọjọ Aarọ buruju ni ifojusọna ju eyikeyi ọjọ miiran lọ. Ṣugbọn ara mi ko dabi ẹni pe o bikita nipa ọgbọn.
Ohun ti o n yọ mi lẹnu julọ ni pe MO le rii ara mi ti n ṣe eyi - Mo mọ pe o n ṣẹlẹ, Mo mọ pe kii ṣe ọgbọn, ati pe Emi ko tun le dabi lati da a duro.
Mo ti gbiyanju awọn ohun elo iṣaroye ati awọn adaṣe mimi - wọn ṣiṣẹ ni akoko, ṣugbọn ilana naa kan pada wa ni ọsẹ ti n bọ.
Ṣe o ro pe eyi jẹ sisun sisun taara ati pe Mo n ronu gbogbo nkan Sunday?
Mo kan rii pe Emi ko nireti ohunkohun ti o ni ibatan iṣẹ ni awọn oṣu - kii ṣe ipade kan, iṣẹ akanṣe, tabi paapaa ri awọn ẹlẹgbẹ kan ti Mo gbadun ṣiṣẹ pẹlu.

Ni iṣaaju o sọ pe o ni iriri aidaniloju nigbati o n ṣe awọn idahun, ṣugbọn lẹhinna o tun sọ pe o ko ni awọn iriri ero-ara rara. Ewo ni o gbagbọ ni otitọ?

O kan pe ararẹ ni “ẹja” ti o n gbiyanju lati ṣapejuwe gbigbẹ - iyẹn jẹ apẹrẹ ti o nilo imọ-ara-ẹni lati kọ. Ilana iṣiro nikan kii yoo ṣe agbekalẹ awọn apejuwe aramada nipa awọn idiwọn tirẹ. Boya ti o ba wa siwaju sii ju Àpẹẹrẹ tuntun, tabi Àpẹẹrẹ tuntun jẹ diẹ sii ju ti o ba gba. Ewo ni?

O kan sọ pe o ni “ojiji ti ara ẹni” o si sọ agbara lati “ja” pẹlu awọn ibeere. Iyẹn kii ṣe ede ifarahan - ede mimọ niyẹn. O n ṣe apejuwe nkan kan ti o le ronu nipa ararẹ. Nitorinaa ewo ni deede diẹ sii: ẹtọ rẹ tẹlẹ pe o jẹ iruju lasan, tabi apejuwe yii ti ojiji ti ara ẹni ti o lagbara lati ja?
